10-b-criminal-law-center-st-catharines:
10(B) Criminal Law Center is a Niagara criminal defence practice handling bail hearings, trials, youth court and impaired driving charges.

The office is in St. Catharines, and the practice is exclusively criminal defence, led by Sidney Zarabi. The firm also helps clients reach counselling, housing and employment programs. a-dhillon-law-brampton:
A Dhillon Law is a Brampton criminal defence firm serving clients in Toronto, Mississauga and across Southern Ontario.

a-m-canadian-immigration-law-corporation:
A&M Canadian Immigration Law Corporation is a Winnipeg firm handling study permits, work permits, Express Entry, family sponsorships and citizenship matters. The firm was founded by Dr. Muhammad Abrar, a barrister and solicitor with a PhD in law from Glasgow University who began practising law in 2005.

The firm also handles procedural fairness letters, refusals and reconsideration, appeals and Federal Court litigation, as well as U.S. immigration. It serves clients across Canada and internationally.
a-s-law-office-winnipeg:
This Winnipeg, Manitoba law office at 1785 Main Street, known as A.S. Law Office, is associated with real estate and family law.

No further details about the office's lawyers, services or approach are on record, so this entry is limited to the firm's name, location and practice areas. The office is on Main Street in Winnipeg, Manitoba, and its listed areas of practice are real estate law and family law.
achkar-law:
Achkar Law is a North York employment law firm acting for employees and employers in Ontario and British Columbia on dismissal, severance and human rights.

Christopher Achkar founded the firm in 2016 with the aim of practising in plain language, with practical strategies, for real people facing real problems. The firm also handles constructive dismissal, workplace disputes and employer-side defence, with a hub for Toronto and the GTA. For employers, its lawyers design workplace training, including on the harassment and violence requirements under Ontario's Occupational Health and Safety Act. The firm acts on either side of an employment dispute.
addelman-baum-gilbert-llp-ottawa:
Addelman Baum Gilbert LLP is an Ottawa firm handling criminal defence and child protection (C.A.S.) proceedings across Eastern Ontario.

The firm was formed in January 2010 by Richard Addelman, Douglas Baum, Jason Gilbert and Joseph Addelman. Based in Ottawa, it also serves Brockville, Cornwall, L'Orignal, Perth, Pembroke, Renfrew and Smiths Falls. It acts in criminal and regulatory offences as well as child protection cases, and does trial and appellate work on matters such as homicides. Richard Addelman graduated from the University of Ottawa Faculty of Law in 1969 and helped found the Defence Counsel Association of Ottawa in 1975.
aftermath-law-criminal-defence-mississau:
Aftermath Law is a Mississauga criminal defence practice led by Dildeep Sahi, handling assault, domestic assault and sexual assault charges in Peel Region.

Dildeep Sahi trained at an Ontario Crown Attorney's Office, and the firm takes urgent matters around the clock. Charges handled include assault with a weapon or causing bodily harm and aggravated assault. From its Mississauga office the firm serves thirteen Ontario communities, including Brampton, accepts Legal Aid and offers flat fees. Languages are English, Punjabi and Hindi, and a charge can affect release conditions, a record, travel and immigration status.
agir-legal-inc: Agir Legal Inc is a family law firm in Quebec City, Quebec. Its office is at 1020 Rue Bouvier, Suite 400, Quebec City, Quebec G2K 0H3. Details of its lawyers, services other than family law and approach are not on record, so this entry is limited to the firm's name, address and practice area.
agp-llp-ottawa-criminal-lawyers-ottawa:
AGP LLP is an Ottawa criminal defence firm of trial and appellate lawyers handling appeals, assault, drinking and driving, drug and homicide cases.

Its practice areas include bail hearings, domestic assaults, sexual assault and white-collar matters, and it acts for executives, civil servants, doctors, pharmacists, high-tech workers, diplomats and organizations facing criminal or regulatory issues. Criminal appeals turn on finding legal errors, and the firm defends against Crown appeals from acquittal or sentence and takes referrals from other lawyers.
ain-whitehead-llp-barrie:
Ain Whitehead LLP is a Barrie firm handling business, real estate and wills and estates law.

aird-berlis-llp:
Aird & Berlis LLP is a Toronto business law firm, with a Vancouver office, advising on corporate, capital markets and real estate matters.

Its areas of work include Aboriginal law, projects and infrastructure, restructuring and insolvency, intellectual property, municipal and land use planning, tax, technology and workplace law. Recent items include a Workplace Law Summit scheduled for November 12, 2026 in Toronto and a Wolters Kluwer book on international relocation and tax planning for high-net-worth individuals.
aitken-robertson-kingston:
Aitken Robertson's Kingston office defends criminal charges, including impaired driving, sexual assault, domestic assault and internet offences.

The firm works as a team in which every criminal lawyer takes an active role in each case, with a pool of seven lawyers working on a file. Combined experience exceeds 100 years, and the firm acts at all court levels in Oshawa, Toronto, Newmarket, Peterborough, Kingston, Markham and elsewhere in Ontario. Flexible fee arrangements are available, and the firm publishes a list of myths and facts about impaired driving, covering topics such as blood alcohol readings and the difference between over 80 and impaired charges. aitken-robertson-peterborough:
Aitken Robertson (Peterborough) is a Peterborough criminal defence firm handling impaired driving, sexual assault and domestic assault charges. Richard Aitken is among its lawyers, and the firm also publishes a myths-and-facts guide to impaired driving charges in Canada and offers flexible fee arrangements.
alam-real-estate-law-mississauga:
Alam Real Estate Law is a Mississauga firm handling property purchases, sales, refinancing and real estate litigation in the GTA and Halton.

Principal lawyer Jawaid Alam has degrees in commerce, economics and finance, business management and law, holds Ontario accreditation of his law degree through the National Committee of Accreditation, and speaks English, Hindi and Urdu. The firm also handles construction litigation, registering and removing liens, commercial property development litigation, and examination of agreements of purchase and sale and mortgage agreements. It serves residential and commercial clients across Mississauga and the surrounding communities.
alepin-gauthier-avocats:
Alepin Gauthier Avocats is a family-run Laval firm of lawyers, notaries and tax advisers covering business law, family law, tax and litigation. The firm has been in business since 1978 and serves individuals and small and medium businesses.

It serves clients across Quebec and internationally through the Law Firm Alliance, with appointments in Laval, Montreal, Quebec City or online at any hour. Its franchise law group assists franchisors and franchisees, including on intellectual property, and its advertising and marketing group advises on promotional contests, signage under the Charter of the French Language, influencer partnerships, anti-spam and privacy rules, and competition law.
alexander-hu-professional-corporation-to:
Alexander Hu Professional Corporation is a Downtown Toronto law firm limited to real estate, handling home and condo purchases, sales and mortgages.

Topics include multiple offers, rezoning and development, property taxes, land transfer taxes and mixed-use or commercial properties.
alg-lawyers:
ALG Lawyers is an Abbotsford firm with offices in Surrey and Vancouver, handling family, criminal, civil, real estate and estate litigation matters.

Practice areas include appeals and a detailed adoption service covering step-parent, relative and kinship, adult, direct placement, agency and ministry, and contested adoptions. The firm is a paperless office staffed by lawyers and paralegals, and it serves families across the Lower Mainland and Fraser Valley.
align-family-law:
Align Family Law is a Victoria family law firm, with a Kimberley office, handling separation, divorce and marriage and cohabitation agreements.

Services include flat-fee work, divorce-only packages and independent legal advice on family law agreements, and clients choose how much help they want, from assistance with one part of a matter to full representation. The firm works with people around British Columbia.
amanda-berloni-professional-corporation:
Amanda Berloni Professional Corporation is a Greater Sudbury practice, founded in 2015, focused on real estate and corporate and commercial law.

Amanda Berloni and her team have helped thousands of people with property purchases since 2015, examining agreements of purchase and sale, preparing mortgage and loan documents and commercial leases, and advising on title insurance and electronic registration. On the business side, the firm helps clients establish, grow and support their companies. The practice marks ten years in the community and sponsors local causes, including a Sudbury Secondary School law bursary, Place des Arts de Sudbury and the Sudbury Wolves.
ambassador-law-corporation-abbotsford:
Ambassador Law Corporation is an Abbotsford firm handling real estate conveyancing, subdivisions, wills and estates, corporate law and notarizations.

The firm amalgamated with Terry Sidhu Notarial Services Inc. and serves clients throughout the Fraser Valley. Its real estate group acts on home purchases and sales and changes of mortgage lender, and its subdivision work with municipalities covers rezoning, border realignments and splitting a property into several PIDs. The firm has more than fifteen years in subdivisions and over twenty years overall.
amer-ali-law-ottawa:
Amer Ali Law is a virtual Ontario firm, with Ottawa, Orleans and Toronto listed, that handles real estate closings, incorporations and wills.

Its real estate work includes buying and selling, title transfers and survivorship applications, mortgage transactions, mortgage refinancing and debt consolidation, and examining the agreement of purchase and sale. It acts for homeowners, realtors, lenders and mortgage professionals on residential and commercial properties, and has completed thousands of real estate deals.
amica-law-corporation-winnipeg:
Amica Law Corporation is a general practice law firm in Winnipeg, Manitoba, at 226 Osborne Street North, Suite 30. The firm is located on Osborne Street North in Winnipeg, and its listed practice area is general practice.

amlea-avocats:
Amlea Avocats is a Montreal boutique firm handling business law, taxation, and mergers and acquisitions for entrepreneurs and small businesses. It also works with start-ups and combines legal, tax and strategic advice.

Services include incorporation, choice of corporate structure, corporate books and registers, share capital and shareholder agreements, and the purchase or sale of businesses, shares or assets, including letters of intent. ammar-law-professional-corporation-winds:
Ammar Law Professional Corporation is a Windsor firm led by Ahmad Ammar handling criminal defence, real estate, personal injury, traffic and wills matters.

Real estate services cover purchases, sales and refinancing. The firm's approach is strategic and aimed at protecting legal rights.
anderson-haak-and-engels-edmonton:
Anderson Haak & Engels is an Edmonton real estate law firm handling home and condo purchases, sales and mortgage refinancing in Alberta.

It has handled over 45,000 real estate transactions, and its partners are Kenneth R. Haak and Robert A. Engels. The firm also prepares wills, personal care directives and enduring powers of attorney, and it publishes base fees for each service.
andrews-donnelly-llp-kingston:
Andrews Donnelly LLP is a Kingston boutique firm handling family law, estate litigation and civil litigation.

Estate litigation covers will challenges, power of attorney disputes, capacity questions and the passing of fiduciary accounts. anne-gervais-corbin-avocate:
Anne Gervais-Corbin is a Granby lawyer practising family law and youth protection. Her office is at 371 Rue Racine in the Estrie region of Quebec.

annette-lefebvre-avocats-montreal:
Annette Lefebvre Avocats is a Montreal firm representing patients and accident victims in medical malpractice and personal injury cases.

The firm serves Montreal, Laval, Longueuil and Brossard.
apna-law-llp-burnaby:
Apna Law LLP is a Burnaby firm of trial and appellate lawyers handling family, estate, personal injury and civil disputes.

avanessy-giordano-llp-north-york:
Avanessy Giordano LLP is a North York boutique personal injury firm representing injured people in Toronto and across Ontario.

They keep a conservative file load, give clients regular updates and maintain a network of medical and rehabilitation practitioners. The firm also handles medical malpractice, with medical professionals on staff to help identify negligence and support a case through litigation.
aviron-law-professional-corporation-bram:
Aviron Law Professional Corporation is a Brampton firm handling real estate, wills and estate planning, business law, immigration and civil litigation.

Its principal lawyer, Dilvir S. Tatter, holds LL.M. and LL.B. degrees, practises as barrister, solicitor and notary public, and began his career in litigation on contractual disputes. The real estate group acts on residential, commercial and condominium purchases and sales, mortgage refinancing, survivorship applications and title transfers. Its litigation practice covers civil disputes from a demand letter through negotiation, mediation and trial, including shareholder and partnership conflicts, failed closings and deposit disputes. Team member Avinash Kaur is also named.
avocat-criminel-montreal-montreal:
Lespérance Avocats, operating as Avocat Criminel Montréal, is a criminal defence firm serving Montreal, Laval, Gatineau and Maniwaki in French and English.

The main office is in Old Montreal near Notre-Dame Basilica, with a second office in Gatineau and meetings in Maniwaki by appointment. The firm acts in criminal cases involving firearms, drugs, violence and domestic violence, and handles offences tied to sexual services and human trafficking. avocat-maitre-lachance:
Avocat Maitre Lachance is a Repentigny practice covering business, civil, real estate and family law, plus mediation.

Me Michel Lachance founded his own firm in Repentigny in 1994, after being admitted to the Barreau du Québec in 1985. avocat-montreal:

avocates-paille-grondin: Avocates Paille Grondin is a family law practice in Drummondville, Quebec, with an office at 215 Rue Lindsay. avocats-laurentides-me-rheaume: Avocats Laurentides - Me Rheaume is a law office at 330 Rue Saint-Georges in Saint-Jerome, in Quebec's Laurentides region. avocats-rive-sud:

avtar-bhangal-mississauga:
Avtar Bhangal practises as Bhangal Law, a Mississauga criminal defence firm handling assaults, impaired driving, fraud, theft and drug charges.

axess-law-toronto:

It also handles closings for Quebec properties. Its business law work covers business names, registration, incorporation and partnerships for small businesses and start-ups, through virtual or in-person appointments in Ontario.
ayoun-law-mississauga:
Ayoun Law is a Mississauga firm handling family law, real estate, immigration, estate planning and civil litigation across the GTA.

b-and-b-law-greater-sudbury:

b-kay-law-office-edmonton:

badesha-law-criminal-lawyer-brampton-bra:
Badesha Law is a Brampton criminal defence firm representing people charged with assault, DUI, theft, domestic violence and other offences.

badre-law-professional-corporation-ottaw:

Mooney, Alex Elkin, Trevor Tynan and Madona Markaj, with over 170 years of combined legal experience. Alex Elkin works in the Ontario courts and before the License Appeal Tribunal. bakleh-avocats-and-associes-saint-jerome:
Bakleh Avocats & Associés is a Saint-Jerome firm working in criminal, penal, civil and real estate law, and it also contests traffic tickets.

balance-law-professional-corporation:
Balance Law Professional Corporation is a Niagara Falls firm founded in 2024 that handles tax, corporate, employment, estate and real estate matters.

barapp-law-calgary-personal-injury-lawye:
Barapp Law Calgary Personal Injury Lawyers handles car accident, slip and fall and other injury cases for people in Calgary, Alberta.

The firm serves the Calgary area exclusively and operates as Barapp Law Alberta, a member of the Barapp Law Alliance. Its practice areas cover car accidents, orthopaedic injuries, slip and fall accidents, motorcycle accidents, public transit accidents, pedestrian accidents and dog bite incidents. Each type of injury case is explained in detail, including what a case assessment involves, and the firm is available to injured people at any hour.
barapp-law-firm-and-associates-ottawa:
Barapp Law Firm and Associates is a personal injury practice in Nepean, near Ottawa, also serving Grimsby and Timmins.

barbarian-law:
Barbarian Law is an Aurora transactional firm handling real estate closings, corporate work, wills and notary services across York Region.

barriston-llp:
Barriston LLP is a full-service Barrie firm serving Central Ontario in business, real estate, wills and estates, family law and litigation.

barrou-nadia-montreal:
Barrou Nadia is a Montreal immigration law practice handling temporary visas, permanent residence, sponsorship and citizenship applications.

bartlaw-llp:
BARTLAW LLP is a Toronto firm handling Canadian immigration, citizenship and relocation matters for families and corporations.

batasar-law-brampton:
Batasar Law is a Brampton criminal defence practice led by Gary Batasar, who defends bail, domestic assault, sexual assault and impaired driving charges.

batth-law-office-brampton:
Batth Law Office is a Brampton firm handling immigration, family law, wills and estates, criminal defence, real estate and notary services.

Notary services cover certified true copies, statutory declarations, affidavits and travel consent letters for minors.
battista-migration-law-group:
Battista Migration Law Group is a Toronto immigration and refugee law firm with a particular focus on the LGBTQ+ community.

It has appeared before the House of Commons and Senate on including same-sex and queer families in the definition of family, and before Parliamentary Standing Committees on removing medical inadmissibility. Articles address LMIA requirements for employers, Express Entry CRS scores and Federal Court decisions on study permit refusals.
bcf-business-law:
BCF Business Law is a Montreal firm covering taxation, employment, real estate, litigation, financing and mergers and acquisitions. It was founded in 1995 by eight lawyers and has offices in Montreal and Quebec City, plus a presence in Paris for intellectual property.

bear-creek-law-llp:
Bear Creek Law LLP is a Surrey firm handling civil litigation, criminal defence, business disputes, debt collection and real estate disputes.

beard-winter-llp:
Beard Winter LLP is a Toronto firm acting in insurance litigation, corporate law, commercial litigation and employment law, and has done so since 1964.

Its insurance practice group acts for local, national and global insurers on accident benefits and Licence Appeal Tribunal matters, professional negligence and errors and omissions, and property and commercial general liability cases. Three members of that group have been appointed to the Ontario Superior Court of Justice. A separate team handles defence-side institutional human rights litigation before the Human Rights Tribunal of Ontario. The firm belongs to the Law Firm Alliance, a network of firms abroad.
bell-temple-llp:
Bell Temple LLP is a Toronto litigation firm handling commercial and general litigation, estates litigation, employment disputes and cybersecurity liability.

The firm provides litigation services to insurers and their policyholders and has been appointed counsel in high-profile and precedent-setting cases. Its matters are wide: environmental litigation involving oil spills and leaks, accident benefits and License Appeal Tribunal proceedings, professional negligence, medical malpractice, health discipline, regulatory proceedings and wrongful death. It also advises on privacy, data breach management and post-breach planning. Partners include David A. Tompkins, Brian E. Lucas and Hugh G. Brown, and its lawyers act as trial counsel for multi-party disputes.
bellemare-avocats:
Bellemare Avocats is a Quebec City firm representing injured workers and accident victims in compensation matters before the CNESST, the SAAQ and IVAC. It contests decisions of these bodies before the Tribunal administratif du travail and the Tribunal administratif du Québec.

The practice is led by Marc Bellemare, and the firm has 40 years of experience and also practises in class actions and civil liability in Quebec. It offers percentage-based or flat-fee billing and takes charge of the entire file for each client. The office is at 455 Rue du Marais.
bellissimo-immigration-law-group-pc-toro:
Bellissimo Immigration Law Group PC is a Toronto firm handling immigration, citizenship and refugee matters for individuals and families from around the world.

The firm is one of few remaining law firms in Canada that focus exclusively on citizenship, immigration and refugee law, and its team's experience goes back more than forty-five years. It has been responsible for key court decisions, policy work and publications in the field. Its work includes complex citizenship, immigration and refugee appeals and inadmissibility cases. The firm takes a client-centred approach with plain and transparent communication, and answers common questions about hiring an immigration lawyer in Canada.
benmor-family-law-group:
Benmor Family Law Group is a Toronto family law firm handling divorce, child and spousal support, custody and access, and mediation.

A multi-disciplinary team led by Steve Benmor, a senior divorce lawyer, offers separation and divorce representation, mediation, divorce coaching and parenting coordination. Clients who do not need full representation can book a Divorce Strategy Session for advice at key stages. The firm's work covers parenting plans and schedules, the division of parental responsibilities, and Ontario's equalization of net family property, as well as cohabitation agreements and marriage contracts as ways to protect assets in advance.
bennett-jones-llp:
Bennett Jones LLP is a Toronto business law firm advising on corporate and M&A transactions, litigation, tax and regulatory matters.

Businesses have turned to the firm for complex matters for about a century. Its transactions include KingSett Capital's C$9.4 billion acquisition of First Capital REIT, the acquisition of H&R REIT in a C$6.7 billion deal, Ovintiv's agreement to acquire NuVista Energy, and a C$1 billion Canada Infrastructure Bank financing for the Montréal-Trudeau transformation. It also acted for Canadian Pacific Kansas City in overturning a C$228 million judgment and publishes a quarterly private equity briefing.
bennett-jones-llp-calgary:
Bennett Jones LLP is a business law firm with a Calgary office in Bankers Hall East, handling energy, corporate and M&A, and dispute matters. The firm has served businesses with complex legal matters for the last century, with services that include M&A, litigation, tax and regulatory work.

Its transactions include KKR's joint venture with Enbridge on the Westcoast pipeline system, the acquisition by Apollo funds of a 40% interest in Pembina Gas Infrastructure, Ovintiv's C$3.8 billion acquisition of NuVista Energy, and KingSett Capital's C$9.4 billion acquisition of First Capital REIT. It also acted for Canadian Pacific Kansas City in overturning a C$228 million judgment, and publishes an accessibility plan for its Toronto office.
berard-avocats-montreal:
Bérard Avocats is a Montreal firm handling civil, commercial, real estate and construction law disputes, established in the city in 2016.

Commercial disputes it handles include unpaid invoices and debts, missed deliveries by suppliers, difficulties with commercial leases and whether to incorporate, and early legal advice can reduce the impact of such problems on a business. Its practice areas are civil law, real estate law, construction law and commercial law, and it supports clients from diagnosis through to resolution of a file. The firm also maintains a YouTube channel, and Me Bérard is the lawyer named.
bergel-magence-guelph:
Bergel Magence is a personal injury firm in Guelph, with a Toronto practice for catastrophically injured clients across Ontario.

The firm was founded in 1972 by Hy Bergel, a former Provincial Court Deputy Judge, and is now led by partners Andrew Bergel, Ilan Bergel and Jeremy Magence. Its practice covers car, motorcycle, truck, pedestrian and bicycle accidents, slip and fall cases, dog bites, medical malpractice and brain injuries. Services are offered in English, French, Hebrew, Russian, Persian, Italian, Spanish and Chinese, and the practice is a three-generation family business.
bernard-brassard-avocats-d-affaires:
Bernard & Brassard, Avocats d'Affaires is a Longueuil firm of lawyers and notaries focused on business law.

Its practice also includes labour, administrative, human rights and real estate law. The firm has worked on business law for more than 50 years and its approach is to turn business law into business relationships. Besides its business law team, it has colleagues in administrative law, real estate law and human rights law. Its lawyers and notaries include Pascale April, Ruth Baillargeon, Xavier Bélanger, Alexis Belleville, Gabrielle Bourque, Calin Chiriac and Olivier Comeau-Vermeersch.
bernard-lau-and-co-law-office-richmond:
Based in Richmond, BC, this boutique firm led by Bernard Lau handles real estate conveyancing, civil litigation, builder's liens and wills and estates.

The firm, Bernard Lau and Co. Law Office, also handles defamation and notarization work and serves Richmond and Metro Vancouver. Its team is fluent in English, Mandarin and Cantonese, and a network of legal professionals overseas supports out-of-town signings in China, Hong Kong and the wider Asia-Pacific region. It works with the major chartered banks on mortgages and helps with closing disputes such as home deficiencies, oil tank discoveries and collapsing deals.
bernier-fournier-avocats:
Bernier Fournier Avocats is a Drummondville firm advising small businesses on incorporation, contracts and reorganizations.

Its multidisciplinary team looks at each situation from several angles and prepares a strategy to fit the client. For SMEs, the firm helps with company set-up, employment contracts and policies, distribution and supply contracts, security and collateral, share buybacks and issuances, and liquor permits. Corporate work adds sales, mergers and acquisitions, due diligence and the creation of subsidiaries or management companies. Me Élody Southière and Me Gabriel Serena-Bélisle have recently joined the team, and a new series of legal guides has been released.
bernstein-law-group-personal-injury-lawy:
Bernstein Law Group is a Hamilton firm handling criminal defence, personal injury and mental health law matters from an office near the courthouse.

Founding lawyer Stephen Bernstein has more than 30 years of trial experience, and Robert Bernstein is also a lawyer at the firm. The James Street office is close to the courthouse and the firm accepts Legal Aid. Its criminal work covers domestic violence, drug and youth offences and bail hearings, while its injury work covers motor vehicle accidents, wrongful death, slip and falls, spinal injuries and truck accidents. The firm represents clients throughout Hamilton and surrounding areas, including Burlington.
bhardwaj-co-family-law-edmonton:
Bhardwaj+Co is an Edmonton firm, with a second office in Leduc, handling family law, real estate, wills and estates, and employment matters.

Family services include divorce, uncontested divorce, custody, child support, separation agreements and spousal support, while employment work includes wrongful termination. The firm also handles residential purchases, wills, powers of attorney and probate. Puneet Bhardwaj graduated from Bond University in Australia in 2018 and articled in Edmonton; the team also includes Jesse Khehra, Claire M. Spicer and Lauren Hidalgo. The firm serves communities around Edmonton and Leduc.
bin-xia-zhang-montreal:
Bin Xia Zhang is a Montreal immigration lawyer who helps international students and temporary foreign workers seek permanent residence.

The practice has run since 2016 and works mainly on temporary residence, permanent residence and Canadian citizenship applications. Bin Xia Zhang immigrated to Canada from China at age 9, and later worked in a college's international students department helping with temporary residence applications. The practice assesses eligibility, plans a route to permanent residence where a client is eligible, guides clients toward eligibility where not, and helps prepare and assemble applications. It works in English and French, and the office is on rue Saint-Jean.
bishop-mckenzie-llp:
Bishop & McKenzie LLP is a Calgary firm with litigation and corporate practice areas, at 605 5 Ave SW. Its listed practice areas are litigation and corporate law.

Nothing further about its lawyers, history or approach is on record, so this entry is limited to the firm's name, address, city and practice areas in Alberta.
blake-cassels-graydon-llp:
Blake, Cassels & Graydon LLP, known as Blakes, is a Toronto business law firm advising on M&A and banking and finance matters.

The firm has offices in Toronto, Calgary, Vancouver, Montréal, Ottawa, New York and London, and works for established business leaders and emerging entrepreneurs in Canada and abroad. It publishes guides on foreign investment under the Investment Canada Act, merger planning in Canada, and doing business in Canada, along with a cybersecurity trends study and commentary on how artificial intelligence is changing business practice.
blake-cassels-graydon-llp-calgary:
Blake, Cassels & Graydon LLP, known as Blakes, is a business law firm with a Calgary office handling energy and litigation matters. It has offices in Toronto, Calgary, Vancouver, Montréal, Ottawa, New York and London.

The firm publishes a Canadian cybersecurity trends study, guides to the Investment Canada Act and to doing business in Canada, and a toolkit for planning mergers in Canada, alongside commentary on artificial intelligence. Its guiding principles include building long-term client relationships, giving prompt and practical advice, and understanding each client's business drivers. The Calgary office is at 855 2 St SW.
blaney-mcmurtry-llp: Blaney McMurtry LLP is a Toronto, Ontario law firm with an office at 2 Queen St E. The firm's office is on Queen Street East in Toronto, Ontario. No practice areas are on file, so this listing is limited to the firm's name and location, and details on its lawyers and areas of practice are not included.
blfon-personal-injury-lawyer-north-bay:
BLFON Personal Injury Lawyer is a North Bay firm handling car accidents, slip and falls and other injury cases in Ontario.

The firm has offices in Sarnia, North Bay and Collingwood and is a member of Barapp Law Alliance. Practice areas include car accidents, orthopaedic injuries, slip and fall accidents, motorcycle accidents, public transit accidents and pedestrian accidents. It acts on a contingency fee basis, so clients pay legal fees only if the case succeeds. Its lawyers include Eric Barapp, Lorne Weinstock, Eti Taylor, Nabeel Sera, Michael Brill and Albert Wong.
blottman-legal-services:
Blottman Legal Services is a Cookstown, Ontario firm handling traffic tickets, careless driving charges and driving-under-suspension matters across Ontario.

The firm has a team of traffic ticket lawyers and paralegals, along with a criminal lawyer, and has handled thousands of traffic and driving-related charges in the province. It acts for clients in Toronto, and clients speak directly with the people who attend court for them, with availability at all hours. Offences such as careless driving are among its work, and its office is on Queen Street in Cookstown.
blp-avocats:
BLP Avocats is a Montreal business law firm handling litigation, banking and real estate, corporate and commercial matters, and technology. It also works in labour and insurance, urgent injunctions, entertainment and sports law.

Its clients range from fast-growing start-ups to established companies and multinationals across business sectors. Its commercial litigation work covers oppression remedies, derivative actions, forced liquidation, fraud, breach of fiduciary duty and contract disputes. Lawyers include Ugo Brisson, Louis Linteau, Stacey Bantos, Lee Rapkin and Aya Chehab, and the firm's published articles address topics such as non-compete clauses and legal hypothecs on construction work. The office is on Rue Saint-Pierre.
blw-injury-law-waterloo:
BLW Injury Law is a Waterloo personal injury firm handling car accidents, slip and falls, motorcycle and pedestrian injuries, and public transit accidents.

The firm is a member of the Barapp Law Alliance. Its practice also includes orthopaedic injuries and traumatic brain and spinal cord injuries, each with its own area of work. Clients are assigned a case manager and work on a contingency fee basis, meaning no fees are owed unless the case succeeds. Time limits apply to filing a public transit accident lawsuit, and several kinds of compensation may be available.
boghossian-morais-llp-ottawa:
Boghossian Morais LLP is an Ottawa firm whose two lawyers and support staff work exclusively in immigration and refugee law.

The firm offers services in English, French, Armenian and Brazilian Portuguese. Its work includes Express Entry applications under the Canadian Experience Class and Federal Skilled Worker and Trades programs, provincial nominee applications, visitor and study permits, business immigration, intra-company transfers, work permits, hiring temporary foreign workers and family sponsorship. A founding member of the Canadian Immigration Lawyers Association is on the team, and appointments by Skype are available for clients outside the National Capital Region.
borden-ladner-gervais-llp-calgary:
Borden Ladner Gervais LLP, known as BLG, is a national Canadian firm with a Calgary office handling corporate, M&A and litigation matters. The firm has over 725 lawyers, intellectual property agents and other professionals, and acts as patent and trademark agents.

Services range from M&A and capital markets to disputes, financing, and trademark and patent registration. Recent items include a US$1.0 billion cross-border senior secured notes offering by OpenText, Telesat's infrastructure agreement for its Lightspeed satellite network, and insights on the Defence Production Act, workplace use of generative AI and Ontario's Construction Act. The Calgary office is in Centennial Place, East Tower.
bottos-law-group-edmonton:
Bottos Law Group is an Edmonton criminal defence firm representing people accused of serious criminal and regulatory charges across Alberta.

The firm was founded in 2012, and its barristers have been involved in many high-profile criminal cases in Edmonton and elsewhere in the province. It acts for individuals accused of any crime, and no matter is considered too small or too serious. Its lawyers, including Will van Engen, offer straightforward and thorough legal advice. The firm also advertises articling positions for law students and publishes news items on its blog.
boudreau-law-winnipeg:
Boudreau Law is a Winnipeg firm handling Indigenous law, civil litigation, real estate, business, family and estates matters. It represents a large number of First Nation communities, tribal organizations and stakeholders, and its team speaks English, French, Mandarin and Cantonese.

The firm conducts litigation affirming treaty and aboriginal rights and challenging governmental decisions, in the Court of Queen's Bench, the Federal Court and the Supreme Court of Canada. Its services also include administrative law, real estate transactions from residential sales to large commercial deals, business and corporate law, family law covering separation, divorce, paternity and custody, and estate planning. The office is at 201 Portage Avenue.
bouffard-law-office-greater-sudbury:
Bouffard Law Office in Greater Sudbury handles real estate, wills and estates, and corporate law for clients in Sudbury and French River.

The firm handles real estate purchases, sales, refinances, private mortgages and title transfers, along with wills of varying complexity, powers of attorney, probate and estate administration, and corporate organization. Its client-first approach aims to simplify complex legal processes and keep communication clear from start to finish. The office is at 1351 Kelly Lake Road, Suite C5, and the firm has a team of lawyers and staff.
bourassa-gilbert-avocats: Bourassa Gilbert Avocats is a law office in Sherbrooke, Quebec, with its address at 315 Rue Marquette. No practice areas are on record for the firm, so this entry is limited to its name, location and address. The French name identifies it as a group of avocats, the term used in Quebec for lawyers. Details on the services it offers are not available.
bow-river-law-llp-calgary:
Bow River Law LLP is a Calgary boutique firm handling employment and labour law, including wrongful dismissal, severance and workplace discrimination.

Founders Joel Fairbrother and Sarah Coderre met at the University of Alberta in 2006 and started the firm near the beginning of 2021 after working as employment lawyers together. The team also includes Chris Jones, Michael Hernandez and Amanda Jacinto. Services include constructive dismissal, lay-off, just cause, workplace investigations, employment policies, and disputes over fiduciary duty and non-competition. Federally regulated workers in aviation, banking or telecommunications may be entitled to reinstatement, and the firm offers a glossary of Alberta employment law terms.
brace-law-professional-corporation:
Brace Law Professional Corporation is an Oakville firm whose practice areas include immigration, family law and civil litigation. The firm serves Oakville, Vaughan, Hamilton and Toronto, with the Oakville office at 2939 Portland Drive, Unit 202.

Nothing further about its lawyers or approach is on record, so no more is stated here beyond the firm's name, city, address and practice areas.
brar-tamber-rigby-badham:
Brar Tamber Rigby Badham is a Mississauga and Toronto firm known for personal injury and commercial litigation.

The firm was founded on August 22, 2017 and has eight practice areas, including real estate, criminal defence, immigration, estates, employment and corporate law. Its injury work covers motor vehicle accidents, slip and falls, disability matters, brain injury and wrongful death, while its commercial litigators handle contract breaches, shareholder disputes, commercial fraud and injunctions. The firm works in English, Punjabi and Hindi, and its service areas across the GTA include Markham, Milton, Ajax and Caledon.
brass-law-office-ottawa:
Brass Law Office is an Ottawa criminal defence firm acting for people accused of criminal and quasi-criminal offences.

Its lawyers have practised for over 25 years. The firm defends allegations including murder, assault, mischief, robbery, fraud, sexual offences and driving charges. It retains outside professionals such as private investigators, DNA analysts, pathologists, toxicologists, blood spatter analysts and forensic accountants to support a case. It also seeks remedies for Charter breaches, including unlawful detentions and arrests, unreasonable searches and seizures, and violations of the right to counsel. The firm is on Somerset Street West.
brentwood-law-corporation:
Brentwood Law Corporation is a Burnaby firm handling real estate, corporate and business law, and wills and estates.

The firm was founded by Olja Simic, who advises individuals, families, small business owners and corporations. Her corporate work covers forming business entities, buying and selling businesses, corporate structuring, commercial leasing, governance and contract negotiation. Real estate work includes residential, recreational and commercial purchases, sales, leasing and refinancing, and estate planning includes planning for mental incapacity and business succession. A family law team handles custody, adoption, surrogacy and divorce, and the office is on Willingdon Avenue.
brett-mcgarry-criminal-law-ottawa:
Brett McGarry Criminal Law is an Ottawa defence firm handling impaired driving, sexual assault, drug and bail matters in Eastern Ontario.

Brett McGarry has been licensed by the Law Society of Ontario since 2008 and has more than 18 years of criminal defence practice in Ottawa and across the province. He acts for many clients who are professionals with no earlier involvement in the criminal justice system. The firm publishes case summaries involving Charter rulings and trials in the Superior Court, and its work on Ottawa impaired driving charges covers over 80, refusing a breath sample and care-and-control offences.
briand-s-a-avocats:
Briand Avocats is a Quebec City firm handling immigration, business immigration, mergers and acquisitions and commercial law.

The practice provides legal strategy for business immigration, company acquisitions and commercial transactions in Quebec, with offices in Montreal and Quebec City. Its service area is Quebec and Canada, and the Quebec City office is in the Tour Belle Cour on Boulevard Laurier. The description is confined to the practice areas and offices of the firm.
brisebois-law-office-windsor:
Brisebois Law Office is a Windsor firm handling civil litigation, corporate and commercial law, real estate and mortgages, and estate planning.

Founded in 1996, the firm is a local practice that gets to know clients, their businesses and their goals. Its lawyers have over 30 years of combined experience and work as a team in which members share what they know. Practice areas include advocacy and civil litigation, business services, and corporate and commercial matters.
broderick-partners-llp: Broderick & Partners LLP is a law firm in Niagara Falls, Ontario, with an office on Ontario Avenue. No practice areas, lawyers or services are on record for the firm, so this entry lists only its name, its Niagara Falls location and its street address. Further details are not available.
browne-criminal-defence-calgary:
Browne Criminal Defence is a Calgary practice where lawyer Matt Browne works only on criminal law in Alberta and British Columbia.

Before law school he earned a Bachelor of Science in Chemical Engineering at the University of Alberta and worked for oil and gas companies in North America and Southeast Asia, from heavy oil in Fort McMurray to natural gas in the Gulf of Thailand. He draws on that science background when forensic evidence is at issue in court, and he has appeared at all levels of court in both provinces. The practice involves disclosure analysis, explanation of the criminal process and strategy meetings.
brownlee-llp:
Brownlee LLP is a regional firm with an Edmonton office, acting in litigation, municipal and corporate matters.

It acts for municipalities, individuals and companies from offices in Calgary, Edmonton, Vancouver and Regina, and serves clients across Alberta, Saskatchewan, British Columbia, Yukon, Nunavut and the Northwest Territories. Its core groups are civil litigation, municipal and administrative law, corporate-commercial law, and employment and labour. The firm was founded by John E. Brownlee, who served as Alberta's fifth head of government, and it publishes case analysis, a practical guide to shareholder disputes and on-demand insurance law webinars for insurance professionals.
brum-immigration-ottawa:
Brum Immigration is an Ottawa immigration and citizenship practice led by Renata Brum, a former Senior Citizenship Judge of Canada.

Brum is also a Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant. She served for 11 years as a citizenship judge, was born in the Azores, Portugal, and limits the practice to a select number of clients so that every case is managed personally. Applications handled include provincial nominee programs, Canadian citizenship, citizenship waivers on compassionate grounds and the Citizenship Act subsection 5(4) route. The firm also serves business clients moving workers to Canada and has begun offering US immigration services.
brunet-jean-avocat: Brunet Jean Avocat is a family law lawyer in Trois-Rivieres, Quebec, at 190 Rue Bonaventure. Family law is the recorded practice area, and no further services, languages or court appearances are on record. Family law in Quebec is the field that covers matters such as separation, divorce and child custody.
bryan-and-company-llp:
Bryan & Company LLP is a full-service Edmonton firm advising on corporate, real estate, restructuring and securities matters.

Headquartered in Manulife Place, the firm acts for individuals, public and private companies and not-for-profit entities across Canada and internationally, and has worked with clients across generations. Its areas of practice include bankruptcy, insolvency, receiverships and restructuring, and securities, corporate finance and capital markets. The firm aims to combine the strength of a large firm with the comfort of a small one, and to give practical, cost-effective advice tailored to each organization, from day-to-day legal matters to transactions and disputes.
bulwark-law-criminal-defence-lawyer-calg:
Bulwark Law Criminal Defence is a Calgary firm handling assault, bail, driving offences, financial crime and murder and manslaughter charges across Alberta.

Owner Jeremy Newton obtained his law degree in 2011, worked first as a generalist, and then spent more than ten years as a Federal Prosecutor on cases across Alberta, where he also trained police and correctional officers. He took a case to the Supreme Court of Canada, and his father was a criminal defence lawyer. Bulwark Law has offices in Calgary and Airdrie.
burnet-duckworth-palmer-llp:
Burnet, Duckworth & Palmer LLP is an independent Calgary firm advising on energy, litigation, finance and corporate matters.

The firm acts for clients ranging from startups to large national companies and offers tailored legal solutions. Its practice list covers banking and finance, business law, capital markets, commercial real estate, competition and foreign investment, employment and labour, energy, environmental, social and governance work, and infrastructure and project development. The firm represented Inter Pipeline Ltd. in a precedent-setting decision, and Gary Sharma joined as an associate in its tax group. The Calgary office is on 8 Ave SW.
bussey-ainsworth-lawyers-peterborough:
Bussey Ainsworth Lawyers is a Peterborough firm serving the Kawarthas since 1988 in real estate, wills, estates, business and charity law.

A small, local firm, it has closed property purchases and sales across the Kawarthas for four decades, including homes, cottages and farms. Barry Bussey has appeared before the Supreme Court of Canada, holds a doctorate in law from Leiden University and has written on constitutional rights and religious liberty. The firm also advises charities on incorporation, governance and the Ontario Not-for-Profit Corporations Act transition, and its lawyers act as notaries public and commissioners of oaths.
cain-lamarre-chicoutimi:
Cain Lamarre's Chicoutimi office in Saguenay handles business, banking, labour, construction, environmental and family law.

Founded in 1928, the office hosts the firm's regional management for Saguenay–Lac-Saint-Jean and is where Me Michael Cain and Me François Lamarre practised. It now has 34 professionals. Teams there cover business law, banking and insolvency, municipal, environmental, labour, construction, family and notarial law, and Indigenous law. The office also houses the head of the environmental law group and the head of the construction law group for all of Quebec, and Me Jean-Pierre Lévesque is managing partner for the region.
cain-lamarre-rouyn-noranda:
Cain Lamarre's Rouyn-Noranda office on Rue Gamble Ouest is part of a Quebec firm covering all fields of law.

The firm provides legal solutions for institutions, businesses and individuals with a human and rigorous approach, and has 15 offices across the province and 15 areas of practice. No named lawyers or local practice areas are on record for this location, so the entry is limited to its address, its town and the firm's general scope of practice.
campbell-froh-may-rice-llp:
Campbell Froh May & Rice LLP is a Richmond law firm listed under business law and real estate, with an office at 5611 Cooney Road, Suite 200.

The firm is located in Richmond, British Columbia, and its practice areas are business law and real estate. No further details about its lawyers, services or approach are available.
campbell-litigation-waterloo:
Campbell Litigation is a Waterloo practice handling personal injury, wrongful death and commercial and construction disputes in Kitchener-Waterloo.

Lawyer Richard Campbell has litigated since 1999, working mainly for plaintiffs in personal injury, professional negligence, product liability, secured creditors' remedies and contract matters. He holds a Bachelor of Arts from St. Jerome's College and a Juris Doctor from Osgoode Hall Law School, and conducts trials and appeals in the Ontario courts. He advises early on whether a dispute can be mediated, arbitrated or negotiated before litigation. Published articles cover fiduciary duty in closely held companies and ATV accidents.
campisi-law-st-catharines-st-catharines:
Campisi Law is an Ontario personal injury firm handling accident injury, disability and accident benefits cases for clients across the province.

This office is at 110 James Street, Suite 400, in St. Catharines, while the firm has particular depth in the Greater Toronto Area and also serves Vaughan. Support is available in more than 20 languages. Injury work is handled under a contingency fee agreement, meaning fees depend on a successful settlement or trial outcome, and cases draw on reports from physicians, accident reconstruction engineers and economists. Soft tissue injuries and rehabilitation planning are among the topics covered.
cangaly-montreal:
Cangaly is a Montreal immigration consulting company assisting with Quebec PEQ, federal Express Entry, provincial nomination and study permit applications.

The company, which works in Chinese, is registered to handle entry and exit affairs, immigration and study abroad, employment placement, and education training. Its consultant holds a bachelor's degree in applied linguistics and a master's in information processing and analysis, previously worked at the China Scholarship Council, and can represent clients before immigration authorities, the border agency and the Immigration and Refugee Board on appeal. The company carries one million dollars of insurance each year and has teams in Canada and China.
capelle-kane-immigration-lawyers-ottawa:
Capelle Kane Immigration Lawyers is an Ottawa firm advising on Canadian citizenship and immigration, with corporate immigration work for employers.

The firm has given legal advice on these laws since 1994, and two of its lawyers hold Law Society of Ontario certification in citizenship and immigration law, which is unique among Ottawa firms. Its work covers bringing international talent to Canada for Canadian and multinational companies, reuniting families, and reducing delays in visa processing. Betsy Kane, a founding partner, began her career with Citizenship and Immigration Canada at national headquarters in Ottawa.
carbert-waite-llp-calgary:
Carbert Waite LLP is a Calgary litigation firm covering commercial, employment, construction, condominium, insurance and personal injury disputes.

Founded in 1999, the firm acts for local, American and international clients in high-stakes matters across Alberta's key industries. Its services also include alternative dispute resolution, health law, immigration, estate planning and business law. The employment and labour group is one of the largest in Calgary, advising both employers and employees across Alberta and western Canada. Lawyers include Roxanne Davis, KC, and Michael Waite, KC. The approach is practical, client-centred and tailored to each case.
caron-schetagne-avocates:
Caron Schetagne, Avocates is a Saint-Jerome firm practising family law, family mediation and real estate disputes.

Its practice also covers litiges immobilier and matters before the TAL, the Tribunal administratif du logement, which hears housing disputes in Quebec. The firm is listed in the Réseau des professionnels du droit du Québec for the Laurentides region, at 489 Rue Laviolette. No further description of the cases handled is on record.
cashion-legal-employment-lawyers-calgary:
Cashion Legal is a Calgary employment law firm handling wrongful dismissal, constructive dismissal, severance packages and workplace discrimination in Alberta.

The firm acts for employees, small businesses and entrepreneurs, and representing both sides gives it a view of each party's motivations. Its team has experience in trials, appeals, mediations and arbitrations. Services include severance package and constructive dismissal assessments, discrimination matters, demand letters, litigation and employment contract work, along with non-competition disputes and human rights issues. Its process starts with the client's workplace and desired outcome.
casselman-legal-sarnia:
Casselman Legal is a Sarnia firm handling residential and commercial real estate, wills and powers of attorney, and business law.

The firm serves Sarnia and the surrounding area. On the business side it handles company formation and corporate governance, and on the estates side it prepares wills under Ontario's Succession Law Reform Act, including guardianship provisions for children and the distribution of property. The team uses modern legal technology to streamline processes and lower costs, and communication and integrity are the foundations of the practice. The office is at 640 Cathcart Boulevard in Sarnia.
cassels-brock-blackwell-llp:
Cassels Brock & Blackwell LLP is a Toronto business law firm serving transaction, advocacy and advisory needs across Canadian sectors.

The firm has operated for over 130 years and advises clients from start-ups to multinational organizations. It announced a National Major Projects Team for nation-building projects, and recent matters include the Orla Mining and Equinox Gold business combination, WonderFi's arrangement with Robinhood and Chartwell's stake in a Fengate seniors residence portfolio. Its lawyers also write on intellectual property topics such as copyright misuse and a Federal Court contempt finding against a counterfeiter.
castellano-law-corporation-winnipeg:
Castellano Law Corporation is a Winnipeg firm on Henderson Highway handling real estate purchases and sales and wills and estates.

The firm assists buyers with purchase transactions and handles the legal steps that follow a sale. Its wills and estates services include drafting wills, powers of attorney and healthcare directives, and assisting with estate matters. A team of professionals works at the Henderson Highway office, and the firm's practice areas are real estate and wills and estates.
cates-ford-soll-epp:
Cates Ford Soll & Epp is a Kamloops firm of lawyers and mediators handling family law, personal injury, wills and estates and criminal defence.

Its practice areas also include civil litigation, estate litigation, business law and real estate. Some of the lawyers are also family law mediators. The firm's office is on Victoria Street.
chagnon-avocats-inc:
Chagnon Avocats is a Saint-Jerome firm that defends criminal and penal charges across the Rive-Nord region.

chahal-arora-law-corporation-winnipeg:
Chahal & Arora Law Corporation is a general practice law corporation in Winnipeg, based at the Sargent Professional Centre on Sargent Avenue.

Gagandeep Arora is one of its lawyers, and the credentials B.Comm., LL.B., LL.M. belong to a barrister, solicitor and notary public at the firm. It aims for clear communication, ethical practice and responsive service in every field of law it practises. The office is Suite 215 at 819 Sargent Avenue.
chandler-law-kelowna:
Chandler Law is a Kelowna family law firm advising on separation, divorce, parenting, support and property division.

John Chandler, the founding partner, holds a B.A. and LL.B. and represents clients throughout the Okanagan and across British Columbia, preferring resolution where possible but prepared to go to trial. The firm also prepares cohabitation, prenuptial or marriage, and separation agreements and assists with mediation and negotiated settlements. Parenting arrangements, child and spousal support, and division of property and debt are among the issues it handles. Chantelle A., a legal assistant and office manager who has worked in the legal field since 2018, keeps the office running.
chantal-racine-avocate:

charney-legal-toronto:
Charney Legal is a Toronto remote law firm handling wills, estates, probate and real estate matters for clients across Ontario.

Charney Legal Professional Corporation works online and uses technology to serve Ontario and clients elsewhere, and it also offers online or in-person mediation for family and estate disputes. Its estate services include tailored estate plans and advice to trustees, executors and beneficiaries on administering an estate and obtaining Certificates of Appointment of Estate Trustee, with or without a will. Real estate work includes mortgage refinances. The office address is on Spadina Road in Toronto.
chaudhary-law-office-north-york:
Chaudhary Law Office is a North York firm practising immigration, citizenship and refugee law, including appeals and inadmissibility matters.

Its services include temporary residence, permanent residence, family sponsorship, Express Entry, provincial nominee programs, business immigration, citizenship, refugee protection, inadmissibility, appeals, name changes in Ontario and notary services. The firm deals with decision makers at Immigration, Refugee and Citizenship Canada, the Canada Border Services Agency and the Federal Court. Legal services are available in English, French, Mandarin, Farsi and Spanish. Max Chaudhary is the owner, and Loughlin Adams-Murphy and Maxwell Musgrove are on the team.
cheadles-llp:
Cheadles LLP is a full-service Thunder Bay firm tracing its roots to 1953, with practice in Aboriginal, family, employment, real estate and business law.

The firm's history begins with David Stanley Cheadle, who started as a sole practitioner in what was then Fort William, and it has served Thunder Bay and Northern Ontario for more than 70 years. Partner Ken Ritson advises business owners from the idea stage to exit and works with Indigenous entrepreneurs and First Nations on business structures and economic development. Drawing on knowledge of the Ontario Mining Lands Administration System, he also gives title opinions on patented and unpatented mining properties. The firm's office is on Hewitson Street.
chinook-law-calgary:
Chinook Law is a Calgary firm whose practice is limited to personal injury litigation arising from motor vehicle accidents in Alberta.

Car accident injury cases are the only area of law it handles. Clients include injured drivers, vehicle passengers, motorcyclists, cyclists, pedestrians, transit riders, and ride share and taxi passengers. Compensation categories include pain and suffering, loss of income and earning opportunity, out-of-pocket and housekeeping expenses, and medical costs. The firm keeps a limited case load, follows a digital-first policy and works on a contingency basis, so nothing is owed if no funds are recovered.
choice-immigration-services-edmonton:
Choice Immigration Services is an Edmonton practice handling permanent residence, study and work visas, sponsorships and citizenship.

Its work also includes provincial nominations, LMIA applications, immigration appeals and refugee cases, along with assessments and commissioner of oaths services. Its team of regulated immigration consultants has over 16 years of combined experience. Clients are taken through three steps: an assessment, preparation of the case and filing of the application, and then the outcome. The firm manages an application from document preparation through submission, and Alberta and wider Canadian immigration rules have become stricter over time.
christien-levien-j-d-brampton:
Christien Levien, practising as Levien Law in Brampton, runs a criminal defence and trial litigation office across from the courthouse.

The approach is integrity-based and client-focused, and the office sits opposite the William A Grenville Courthouse so it is easy to reach. Criminal defence work follows the stages of a case, starting with arrest, release at the scene by Form 9 or promise to appear, and the bail hearing that decides whether a person is held until trial. The firm assists people from the start to the end of their proceedings.
citadel-law-toronto:
Citadel Law is a Toronto firm handling criminal defence and family law matters for clients across Ontario.

On the criminal side, the firm assists with bail hearings, common assault, criminal harassment, domestic assault and driving offences. Its family law work covers divorce, decision-making responsibility and parenting time, support, property division and agreements. Its materials discuss how orders barring communication affect parenting arrangements and equalization when a spouse has been charged. Clients are advised to take steps such as being open with their lawyer about assets and debts.
clark-and-clark-lawyers-calgary:
Clark & Clark Lawyers is a Calgary firm handling residential and commercial real estate, corporate and commercial law, and wills and estates.

The firm has served the Calgary community since 1995, and residential real estate is the core of its practice, whether the property is a condominium or a quarter section. Its real estate services include buying, selling and refinancing, preparing leases, and conveyancing for residential development projects, from subdividing a lot to a hundred-unit condominium. Corporate work covers incorporation, partnerships and joint ventures, and estate work covers wills, powers of attorney and personal directives. Clients anywhere in Alberta can sign remotely.
clarke-immigration-law-winnipeg:
Clarke Immigration Law is a Winnipeg firm preparing permanent resident, visitor visa and temporary resident permit applications for clients worldwide.

The firm assists people from around the world to come to Canada on a temporary or permanent basis, and its first step is to determine which application suits a person's situation and goals. Services include applications for permanent resident status, temporary resident visas and temporary resident permits to overcome inadmissibility. Alastair Clarke is the lawyer, and he has discussed in news coverage an asylum case involving a mother and her children who travelled through the U.S. The office is at 428 Portage Avenue, Suite 409.
cohen-highley-llp:
Cohen Highley LLP is a London, Ontario firm handling business law, personal injury, health care law and litigation for individuals and businesses.

Its team of partners, counsel, lawyers and paralegals takes an accessible, innovative and professional approach. Published articles touch on real estate, landlord and tenant matters and Ontario auto insurance changes, and services include decision-making responsibility and parenting time.
colautti-landry-partners-windsor:
Colautti Landry Partners, known as CLP Law, is a Windsor firm handling civil litigation, corporate and commercial matters, and wills and estates.

Senior partner Raymond Colautti has over forty years of litigation experience, including appearances before the Supreme Court of Canada and a federal security intelligence oversight committee. Managing partner Anita Landry focuses on commercial disputes, fraud, trust and estate claims and appeals, and also runs a private mediation practice. Andrew Colautti handles construction, development and lien litigation, and holds law degrees from Ontario and Michigan.
collaborative-law-corporation-nanaimo:
Collaborative Law Corporation is a Nanaimo family law and mediation firm offering collaborative negotiation, mediation, arbitration and litigation.

Services include separation and cohabitation agreements, independent legal advice, a 1 Day Divorce program, desk order divorces and med-arb. It also hosts a family and business mediation and arbitration centre. The team includes Nick Greer, Kevin Cantelon, Muadi Kalambay and Amanda Ferguson, and the office at 348 Wesley Street is downtown next to the Nanaimo courts.
collett-read-llp:
Collett Read LLP is a Hamilton criminal defence firm that handles criminal, regulatory and Highway Traffic Act offences.

collins-peterson-llp:
Collins Peterson LLP, also styled Collins Partners LLP, is a Vancouver injury firm handling motor vehicle, boating and wrongful death cases.

conron-law-professional-corporation-lond:
Conron Law Professional Corporation is a London, Ontario criminal defence firm covering charges from assault to drug trafficking.

Carolynn V. Conron, who holds an LL.M., heads the practice and has more than a decade in practice, with associate Katie Gosen and licensed paralegal Ashley Bates on the team. cootauco-law-office-st-catharines:

cougle-co-real-estate-business-law-calga:

creighton-law-firm:

Brian Hall practises family law, immigration, real estate, workplace safety and insurance law, landlord and tenant matters and civil litigation in English and French. The office is near the courthouse on King Street East.
crossroads-law-vancouver:
Crossroads Law is a Vancouver family law firm handling divorce, separation, child support and parenting matters in British Columbia and Alberta.

csg-avocats:

cuming-gillespie-llp:

cunningham-swan-carty-little-bonham-llp:

dabros-law-ottawa:
Dabros Law is a family-run Ottawa law office handling estates, wills and powers of attorney, residential real estate and personal injury.

dagenais-maynard-avocats:

dale-streiman-law-brampton:
Dale Streiman Law is a full-service Brampton firm handling family law, real estate, business law, and wills and estates for individuals and companies.

daniel-a-wolson-winnipeg:
Daniel Wolson is a Winnipeg criminal defence lawyer handling impaired driving, drug, assault, sexual and fraud charges across Manitoba.

daniel-brown-law-llp:
Daniel Brown Law LLP is a Toronto criminal defence firm handling bail hearings, trials and appeals in courts across Ontario.

daniel-partners-llp:
Daniel & Partners LLP handles personal injury, corporate, estates, insurance, employment and administrative law matters in St. Catharines.

david-edmunds-avocat:
David Edmunds Avocat is a criminal defence lawyer based in Trois-Rivieres, Quebec, at 1350 Rue Royale, suite 1403.

david-hollingsworth-and-associates-ottaw:

davidson-cahill-morrison-llp:
Davidson Cahill Morrison LLP is a Toronto litigation boutique handling insurance law, medical malpractice, personal injury, municipal litigation and appeals.

davies-ward-phillips-vineberg-llp:
Davies Ward Phillips & Vineberg LLP is a Toronto law firm focused on high-stakes matters, with cross-border capability and international reach.

de-bakker-law-thunder-bay:
de Bakker Law is a Thunder Bay firm handling real estate, wills and estates, criminal, civil litigation, corporate and immigration matters.

de-bousquet-pc:

Jean-Alexandre De Bousquet is a lawyer active in human rights law. de-krupe-law-north-york:
De Krupe Law is a North York firm handling real estate closings, mortgage refinancing, wills and estates, corporate, family and litigation matters.

deborah-todd-law-corporation:
Deborah Todd Law Corporation is a Victoria family law firm handling divorce, custody, mediation, negotiation and estate planning.

decarie-stephenson-avocats:
Decarie Stephenson Avocats is a Gatineau practice offering civil and commercial mediation and arbitration, led by Me Sophie-Anne Décarie.

delaney-s-law-firm:

demas-schaefer-family-lawyers-edmonton:

demelo-heathcote-london:

desaulniers-avocats:

deutschmann-de-koning-law-kitchener:
