On malpractice, the firm covers harm from misdiagnosis, surgical or prescription errors and failure to diagnose or monitor a condition, and its team are trial lawyers. The office is at 172 Battle Street in Kamloops, British Columbia.
korman-and-company-toronto:
Korman & Company is a Toronto firm of real estate lawyers, with notary public services offered alongside other areas of practice.

The firm's practice includes a real estate section, other areas of practice, notary public services and a team of lawyers. Little further detail about the firm's approach, history or clients is available, so this entry is limited to its location and practice areas.
kormans-llp:
Kormans LLP is a Mississauga firm acting in real estate closings, wills and estates, and corporate and commercial law for clients across Ontario.

Real estate work runs from going over purchase agreements and completing title searches to coordinating with lenders, covering residential and commercial purchases, sales, leasing and mortgages, as well as cottages, farms and condos. The firm also assists landlords and tenants. On the business side, it handles incorporations and business structure, contract drafting and revision, mergers, acquisitions and business sales, and franchise law, along with wills and estate matters.
kraska-law-mississauga:
Kraska Law is a Mississauga firm led by former federal prosecutor Robert S. Kraska, offering criminal defence, criminal appeals and notary services.

Robert Kraska worked with the Public Prosecution Service of Canada before focusing his practice on criminal law, and the firm has over 40 years of combined defence and prosecution experience. Charges range from assault, impaired driving and theft to large frauds and traffic offences. Other services include wills, independent legal advice, record suspension applications, victim compensation applications and civil litigation. Services are offered in English and Polish, and the firm is available for bail hearings at all hours.
ksw-lawyers:
KSW Lawyers is a Surrey full-service firm handling business, corporate, employment, criminal defence and insurance defence matters since 1973.

The firm began as Kane, Shannon & Weiler, opening in North Delta to serve Surrey and nearby communities. It now has offices in Surrey, South Surrey/White Rock, Abbotsford, Langley and Vancouver, and its lawyers serve the Fraser Valley and Lower Mainland. Services include business litigation, business tax, charities and non-profit work, labour relations and union advice, and employment law and human rights. The firm is associated with a 2026 British Columbia Supreme Court decision in KingSett Mortgage Corporation v. Lumina Eclipse Limited Partnership.
kung-lo-jia-llp:
Kung, Lo & Jia LLP is a Markham firm handling civil litigation, employment, construction, corporate and real estate matters, plus wills and estates.

The firm was founded by Jason Huang-Kung, Justin Lo and Andrew Jia, and it serves individuals and businesses across York, Peel, Durham, the Greater Toronto Area and the rest of Southern Ontario. Work includes wrongful dismissal and severance matters, construction liens, shareholder agreements, commercial leases, probate applications, and residential and commercial real estate purchases, sales and refinancing. Other team members include Arsalan Wancho, Fawad Ghulami, Tammy Kung and Rachel Lee, and the firm offers multilingual support.
la-rosee-avocat-inc-montreal:
La Rosée Avocat is a Montreal firm handling family, civil, criminal, housing and immigration law from Boulevard Henri-Bourassa Est.

The firm works in French and covers divorce, child custody and support, contract drafting and disputes, civil liability, criminal defence, visa applications and citizenship procedures. It also handles youth law, housing law, and mediation of small-amount disputes. Its values are transparency, integrity and respect, and it gives weight to the human side of legal work. It also gives private courses in law for people who need help in several subject areas.
lakeshore-law-oakville:
Lakeshore Law is an Oakville firm covering corporate and commercial law, construction, criminal, family and civil litigation, and immigration matters.

Arjun Sekhon graduated from the University of Windsor in 2021 and was admitted to the Ontario bar in 2022, with corporate, commercial, criminal, family and immigration work. Daniel Ibrahim, of counsel, practises litigation before the Ontario Court of Justice and Superior Court of Justice, with municipal, criminal, family and civil work, plus probate applications, wills and powers of attorney. The team has backgrounds in larger firms and in-house roles, and the firm takes on pro bono work and mentorship.
lakin-afolabi-law-london:
Lakin Afolabi Law is a London, Ontario criminal defence firm that focuses on sexual assault and domestic assault charges.

The firm also defends other criminal charges and has offices in London and Kitchener. The team includes Lakin Afolabi, Howsikan Kugathasan and Alyssa Zoltek. Lakin Afolabi has more than fifteen years of experience defending thousands of charges and has litigated over 20 jury trials to verdict. The firm takes a human approach to law built on listening, planning strategy with the client and then defending, and prospective clients can book appointments online.
lalande-personal-injury-long-term-disabi:
Lalande Personal Injury & Long-Term Disability Lawyers is a Hamilton firm handling serious personal injury, wrongful death and disability cases.

The firm has represented clients in Hamilton and throughout Ontario since 2003 and is centred on trial lawyer Matt Lalande, who comes from a family of trial lawyers and judges practising since 1973. His practice has five areas: wrongful death, injured children, serious personal injury, denied long-term disability and wrongful dismissal. The firm handles motor vehicle collisions and pedestrian and cycling injuries among other accidents, and serious cases get direct involvement from an experienced trial lawyer.
lama-law-real-estate-lawyer-oakville:
Lama Law Real Estate Lawyer is an Oakville firm helping clients buy, sell and refinance homes across the Greater Toronto Area.

Pav Lama earned a bachelor's degree at York University and a law degree at the University of Birmingham in the UK, and was admitted to the Ontario bar in 2016. The firm also handles corporate law, commercial law, notary services, and wills and powers of attorney. It offers fixed fee closings, and the office is on Speers Road in Oakville.
lambert-avocats-montreal:
Lambert Avocats is a Montreal firm handling civil, administrative, criminal, penal and disciplinary law, including SAAQ and injury matters.

The firm works in French, offers percentage-based, hourly or mixed fee arrangements and is available around the clock in criminal matters. Its civil liability work covers injuries from unsafe public places and collapsed stairs or balconies. A further area is disciplinary law, including nurses facing complaints before the Ordre des infirmières et infirmiers. The practice is located on McGill College Avenue and represents clients through each stage, from explaining rights and obligations to filing proceedings and appearing in court.
lambert-boenders-employment-lawyer-toron:
Lambert Boenders is a Toronto employment and human rights law practice that advises both employees and employers on termination and workplace issues.

Lambert earned a B.A. (Hons) from Victoria College at the University of Toronto and a J.D. from Osgoode Hall Law School in 1994, entered employment and human rights practice in 2009 and was admitted to the Ontario bar in 2010. Before practising law he worked for more than twenty-five years in business, including as Vice-President of Operations with an international insurance company. Services include examining employment offer letters and contracts, performance management and improvement issues, and non-solicitation and non-competition clauses. The office is on Queen Street West.
lambert-law-victoria:
Lambert Law is a Victoria firm handling personal injury, medical malpractice, motor vehicle tribunal matters and general litigation.

Rory Lambert and his legal team have represented members of the Victoria community for more than 30 years. On medical malpractice, the firm works with doctors, nurses and other medical professionals who assess a case before a decision to sue, and litigation against medical professionals can be costly and take several years. In British Columbia a general two-year limitation period applies, measured from the last date of the treatment alleged to be negligent.
lamont-law-hamilton:
Lamont Law is a Hamilton personal injury firm that focuses on serious and catastrophic injuries, accident benefits and long-term disability denials.

Cases for Hamilton and the GTA include motor vehicle accidents, dog attacks, slip and falls, medical and nursing home negligence, wrongful death, brain injuries and spinal cord injuries, and the firm only takes catastrophic injury matters with an estimated value above $50,000. Erica Lamont, who was born in Hamilton, studied at the University of Waterloo and the University of Calgary and was admitted to the Law Society of Ontario in 2014. She is joined by lawyer Braden Adsett and paralegals Carrie Stewart and Phil Vivian.
lamprey-law-professional-corporation-bar:
Lamprey Law is a Barrie firm handling real estate, mortgages, wills, powers of attorney and estate administration for clients in Barrie and Simcoe County.

Peter Lamprey graduated from Osgoode Hall Law School in 1979, began practising in 1981 and has worked exclusively in the Barrie area since. Jenna Goorts, an Osgoode graduate of 2017 who first worked at the firm as a summer student, practises real estate and wills and estates, and serves on a Simcoe County board for MADD Canada. After years in an early twentieth-century house on Worsley Street, the firm moved to Bayfield Street, where the office has parking and is wheelchair accessible.
lange-law-winnipeg:
Lange Law is a Winnipeg firm focused on real estate, wills and estate planning, and estate administration, with service at the client's door.

The firm prefers to help first-time home buyers, people selling a long-held family home, those building a dream home and families settling a loved one's estate, rather than banks or large corporate clients. Under its at-your-door service, a team member known as the Runner brings the documents to the client's home and returns them to the office, so clients can avoid travelling downtown. The firm assists several generations of the same family.
laperle-bouchard-avocats:
Laperle Bouchard Avocats is a Drummondville firm handling criminal law, penal law and youth law from an office at 164 Rue Saint-Georges.

The lawyers also accept legal aid mandates, and the firm presents settlement options when a trial is not needed while remaining ready to go to court when it is. Its lawyers negotiate and regularly plead before the courts. The firm's values are trust, competence and friendliness, and it handles family law alongside criminal matters.
laredo-law-toronto:
Laredo Law is a Toronto estates firm preparing wills, trusts and tax-aware succession plans and acting in estate administration.

The firm was founded in 2007 by Lisa Laredo, a Certified Trust and Estate Practitioner through STEP Canada who belongs to the Canadian Bar Association, the Ontario Bar Association and the Estate Planning Council of Canada. She also teaches accredited programs for lawyers and writes for legal journals. Associate lawyer Ana Wagner and a legal administrative assistant are on the team. The firm also has a real estate law practice and publishes a blog on wills and estates topics in plain language. The office is on Davisville Avenue.
larson-lawyers-professional-corporation:
Larson Lawyers Professional Corporation is a Thunder Bay firm handling real estate, wills, powers of attorney and probate.

The firm has served Thunder Bay since 1996, and its founder, Rene Larson, has worked with people on legal issues for five decades. It keeps traditional personal service alive, including house calls and hospital visits for wills and powers of attorney. Real estate work covers drafting offers, closings, family transfers, refinancing, land development for builders, zoning variances and appearances before the Ontario Land Tribunal. It also handles family law, corporate work and trusts, and its office is on Victoria Avenue East.
lawden-kunal-kapoor-law:
LawDen, run by Kunal Kapoor Law Professional Corporation in Brampton, handles real estate, immigration, family, criminal and civil matters. Its practice areas also include insurance matters.

Litigation work covers contract and property disputes and employment issues, from pre-trial negotiations and mediation through to the courtroom. Kunal Kapoor is the barrister and solicitor, Ambica Kapoor is office manager, and a team member is listed as Saurav K. The firm offers tailored legal strategies, confidentiality and flexible payment options for individuals and businesses. Its office is on Camberley Crescent in Brampton.
laws-and-beyond-calgary:
Laws & Beyond is a Calgary firm handling family law, civil litigation, wills and estates, real estate and employment matters.

Family matters include separation, divorce, emergency protection orders, spousal and child support, parenting arrangements, marital agreements and family violence, and Alberta now frames custody as decision-making responsibility and parenting time. The firm uses negotiation, mediation and other alternative dispute resolution where feasible but is prepared to go to court when required. It also offers notarization and commissioning services, and its approach is tailored to each client's goals and circumstances.
lawyer-up-canada-richmond-hill:
Lawyer UP Canada is a Richmond Hill criminal defence firm representing people charged with offences such as fraud, theft and assault in Ontario.

The firm provides full criminal defence services to people charged with criminal offences who also face related legal consequences. The charges it covers in plain language include fraud, theft, assault, robbery, mischief, failure to remain at the scene of an accident, and harassment and uttering threats. The office is located on Highway 7 in Richmond Hill.
lawyerg-calgary:
LawyerG is a Calgary law office led by Gurpreet Aulakh, handling real estate, corporate and commercial law, wills and family matters.

The firm is full service, with a focus on real property and on corporate and commercial work. For home buyers and sellers it covers real property reports and land title transfers; for families it also prepares prenuptial and cohabitation contracts, and it offers notary services such as travel documents. Civil litigation and personal injury are also practice areas. Gurpreet Aulakh holds law and business degrees, a cyber crime investigation certification, and memberships in the Law Society of Alberta, Legal Aid Alberta and the Calgary Bar Association.
lazar-law-firm-london:
Lazar Law Firm is a London, Ontario firm covering real estate, business, wills and estates, family law and paralegal services.

Its real estate practice handles residential and commercial purchases and sales, mortgage refinances and private mortgages, with title searches and closing coordination. The business side covers asset and share transactions, business purchases and sales, commercial leasing, start-ups and incorporation. Wills services include single, multiple and mirror wills for couples, plus estate administration and applications for a Certificate of Appointment of Estate Trustee. Its paralegal and civil services extend to lower-value civil court matters, the Landlord and Tenant Board and Provincial Offences Court.
lca-avocats-inc:
LCA Avocats is a Terrebonne firm, with offices in Repentigny and Rosemère, handling civil, real estate, construction, business, labour and family law.

Its mission is to provide a full range of legal services to individuals, entrepreneurs and small and medium-sized businesses. Its fields also include housing law, municipal law and regulatory penal law, and the lawyers act as legal advisers and business partners. Recent publications cover an employer's duties for company vehicles and employees' driving licences, a Tribunal administratif du logement ruling on pet clauses in leases, and Quebec's new régime d'union parentale.
ld-law-llp-toronto:
LD Law LLP is a Toronto firm handling real estate closings, mortgage refinances, title issues and title insurance across Ontario.

The firm acts for buyers, sellers and owners of residential and commercial property, and also takes on real estate litigation. Further practice areas include wills and estate planning, family law and business law, along with employment, corporate and commercial matters. David Baptista dos Reis and Daniel La Gamba are the lawyers named, and real estate services are also offered in Brantford.
le-cabinet-m-saint-jerome:
Le Cabinet M is a Saint-Jerome firm that acts for people seeking compensation after an accident, a crime or a disability.

Its lawyers and their team act across Quebec, including the Greater Montreal area, and the firm works in French.
league-and-williams-lawyers-victoria:
League and Williams Lawyers is a Victoria, BC firm handling personal injury, estate, business, marine and real estate law.

The firm is headquartered in Victoria with offices in Vancouver, Duncan, Campbell River and Kelowna, and serves clients from around the world with legal issues in British Columbia. It brings more than 160 years of experience to its areas of law. Its work covers car accidents, estate planning and disputes, including who can dispute a will in BC, and marine matters such as boating accidents, seized boats and anchoring or mooring concerns.
leblanc-dingman-avocats:
Leblanc & Dingman Avocats is a Sherbrooke firm handling criminal defence and penal matters, with youth law also among its areas of practice. It operates from an office on Rue Belvedere Nord.

The lawyers work on defence for people facing an investigation, a charge or a trial, and follow the case through each stage of the procedure. The firm takes time to understand each situation, assess what is at stake and build a strategy suited to the client, anticipating how a file may develop rather than only reacting. Confidentiality and a personalized approach are central to its practice.
lecker-and-associates-north-york:
Lecker & Associates is a North York employment law firm acting only for employees in wrongful and constructive dismissal and severance matters.

Founded in 1984, the firm has worked for Ontario employees for over 40 years and has acted for more than 10,000 clients. Its subjects also include discrimination, harassment, denied disability benefits and forced resignation from toxic workplaces. Its lawyers have litigated precedent-setting cases, and the firm serves Toronto and North York, working for Ontario workers.
legal-focus-llp:
Legal Focus LLP is a Windsor firm handling personal injury, estates and probate, real estate and civil litigation matters.

Partner Marcela S. Aroca was appointed a judge of the Tax Court of Canada. The team includes a partner in civil litigation and personal injury, associates in civil, tax and estate litigation, wills and estates, property disputes, corporate, commercial and real estate work, and law clerks who are also licensed paralegals. The firm is guided by integrity, transparency and client education, and its personal injury work covers motor vehicle accidents and slip and fall cases.
leiter-rahme-attorneys-inc-montreal:
Leiter Rahme Attorneys is a Montreal firm handling Canadian and American immigration law for clients around the world.

The firm has its head office in Montreal and additional offices in the Middle East and the Gulf. Clients come from dozens of countries, among them China, Iran, Lebanon, France, Mexico, India, Nigeria, Brazil and the Philippines. The lawyers serve clients in English, French, Mandarin, Spanish, Arabic, Portuguese, Romanian, Italian and Hebrew, and assist applicants with temporary or permanent visa applications and with challenging decisions by immigration authorities.
lemieux-litigation-barrie:
Lemieux Litigation is a Barrie boutique litigation firm handling personal injury, employment and family law matters.

Its local lawyers serve all of Simcoe County, including Barrie, Innisfil, Orillia, Midland and Alliston, as well as Bradford, Newmarket and Collingwood. Injury work covers motor vehicle accidents, slip and falls and long-term disability. On the employment side the firm handles wrongful termination and workplace sexual harassment. Family law matters include divorce, child and spousal support, custody and access, and separation and parenting agreements. Nicole Meringolo and Melissa Ritter are the lawyers featured.
lerners-llp:
Lerners LLP is a full-service law firm based in London, Ontario, with additional offices in Toronto, Waterloo Region and Strathroy.

The firm has served clients across Ontario for more than 95 years and now has more than 130 lawyers. Its approach centres on listening to the client's story before shaping an outcome. Topics the firm addresses include workforce planning for manufacturers, structuring manufacturing facility acquisitions to limit real estate risk, and how long estate litigation takes in Ontario, from mediation through discovery, trial and appeals.
leveille-et-associes:
Leveille et Associes is a Gatineau firm established in 1996 handling family law, criminal law, housing disputes, and civil and commercial matters. A team of lawyers works across many areas of law.

The firm also acts in criminal defence and in landlord and tenant matters before the housing tribunal, the Régie du logement. The office is at 255 Boulevard Saint-Joseph in Gatineau.
lewis-et-associes-sencrl:
Lewis et Associes SENCRL is a Montreal-listed firm practising immigration and refugee law, from refugee protection to family sponsorship.

liberty-law-llp-edmonton:
Liberty Law LLP is an Edmonton criminal defence firm that represents people charged with offences at every level of Alberta courts.

The firm practises criminal defence only. Its lawyers appear in Provincial Court, the Court of King's Bench and the Court of Appeal, and matters include murder, sexual assault, drug and weapon offences, domestic violence, impaired driving and appeals. Besides its downtown Edmonton office, it has offices in Grande Prairie and Fort McMurray, and it serves Alberta, Saskatchewan and the Northwest Territories. A team of more than twenty lawyers includes senior trial and appellate counsel.
lions-gate-law-corporation-vancouver:
Lions Gate Law Corporation is a Vancouver firm handling real estate conveyancing, mortgage refinances, incorporations, and wills and estates.

Services include commercial conveyancing and mortgage refinances, and its lawyers are mobile. The firm's office is on West Georgia Street in downtown Vancouver. Its lawyers hold degrees from the University of British Columbia, the London School of Economics and McGill University.
llf-lawyers-llp:
LLF Lawyers LLP is a Peterborough firm, founded in 1993, with a second office in Bobcaygeon and practice in business, real estate, estates and litigation.

The firm has 16 lawyers and more than 50 professionals in total, and acts for individuals and corporations with a collaborative, budget-conscious approach. It also advises nonprofits and charities on governance and procedural matters. Partners include Phil Aldrich, Jim Baird, Emmet Connolly, Jeff Lanctot, Pete Lawless, Le Nguyen, Chris Russell and Tammy Williams. Recent articles cover the October 2026 ONCA deadline for share capital social clubs and new ISC registry rules. The Peterborough office is on Aylmer Street North.
lm-law-group-toronto:
LM Law Group is a Toronto immigration firm handling study permits, work permits, permanent residence, visitor visas, Express Entry and citizenship applications.

Founded in 2007, the firm has a team of about 25. Partners are Elizabeth Long, Aadil Mangalji and Ziah Sumar, with associates including Erin Levitsky and Catanne Boan-Mitchell. Services are organized by client group: employers, students, permanent residents, workers, visitors, citizens and entrepreneurs. Each case is assessed individually so that the immigration path fits the person, with an empathy-focused approach.
lmrt-immigration-services-montreal:
LMRT Immigration Services is a Montreal team of regulated immigration consultants handling asylum cases, family sponsorship and Express Entry.

The firm has worked on refugee and sponsorship files since 2017, and its founder, Loujin Khalil, is a regulated consultant authorized to appear before the Immigration and Refugee Board. His background includes business immigration streams such as entrepreneur programs, the Start-up Visa and owner-operator. Services are offered in English, French, Arabic and Persian, Quebec programs are covered, appointments can be held online, and guides are published on topics such as the four divisions of the Immigration and Refugee Board of Canada.
longfield-law-professional-corporation-b:
Longfield Law Professional Corporation is a family-operated Brampton firm covering real estate, wills, estates and trusts, and corporate and business law.

Randall A. Longfield founded the firm in 1986, his son Michael joined in 2013, and Meaghan Longfield joined in 2019 to oversee the corporate department. Clients are served throughout Peel and Halton, including Caledon, Bolton, Georgetown, Halton Hills, Oakville, Burlington, Mississauga and Milton. Real estate work includes residential and commercial purchases and sales, mortgage financing and refinancing, private mortgages and title insurance. The estates side prepares wills and powers of attorney, and assists executors with administration and probate.
loopstra-nixon-llp:
Loopstra Nixon LLP is a full-service business and public law firm in Etobicoke, Ontario, with practice groups ranging from real estate to municipal law.

Practice areas include banking and financial services, litigation and dispute resolution, land use planning and development, municipal and insurance litigation, sports law, franchising, technology and intellectual property, labour and employment, wills, trusts and estates, and bankruptcy, insolvency and restructuring. Partners include Jason Beitchman, Mark J. Lieberman, Daniel Steinberg and Matthew Vella, and the firm works beyond Canada through affiliates in the LawExchange International network.
lou-vadala:
Lou Vadala Professional Corporation is a Kingston law office, founded in 2000, handling real estate, wills and estates, corporate and family matters.

Real estate, wills and estates and corporate law are the main areas, with family law, litigation and notary public and Commissioner of Oaths services among other practice areas. The team has served clients across the province and worldwide for more than 20 years. Team members include Lou Vadala, Anthony Vadala, Jake Wright, Steven King, Dianne LaFortune and Josh Vaters. Corporate work is aimed at entrepreneurs, founders, owners, lenders, partnerships and small businesses.
lt-lawyers-llp-calgary:
LT Lawyers LLP is a Calgary boutique firm representing injured people and those denied long-term disability benefits in Alberta and British Columbia.

Co-founders Ryan Lee and Peter Trieu lead the firm; Lee previously acted for insurance companies in personal injury cases and has appeared before the Alberta Court of King's Bench and the Supreme Court of British Columbia. Two of its lawyers are former criminal prosecutors, and Daniel Gelb, Faye Gelb and Bridget Belsher are also on the team. Matters include car crashes, injuries caused by negligence and long-term disability denials and terminations, with strategies ranging from settlement to trial.
lucenti-orlando-professional-corporation:
Lucenti Orlando Professional Corporation is a North Bay firm practising family, estates, corporate, real estate, tax and civil litigation law.

Robert Lucenti joined the established firm of Ernest Loukidelis and Michael G. Bolan in 1969, and several of the firm's lawyers were later appointed to the Superior Court of Ontario. Sandro Orlando joined in 1984, Mark Lucenti in 2009 and Ryan Leckie in 2017. Family law work highlights collaborative family law, separation, marriage and cohabitation agreements, divorce and support. Civil litigation covers employment disputes and debt collection, and the firm has practised in North Bay for more than 55 years.
luk-associates:
Luk & Associates is a Markham law firm offering family law, real estate, corporate, immigration, and wills and estates services across Ontario.

The office is on Highway 7 in Markham, Ontario. The firm's five practice areas together cover personal matters such as family separations and estate planning, property purchases and sales, and corporate and immigration work. Details about individual lawyers or the firm's history are not given in this profile, which sets out only the firm's location, the area it serves and its practice areas.
lydia-h-thomson-law-corporation-kelowna:
Thomson Law is a small Kelowna firm centred on family law and family mediation, serving Kelowna, West Kelowna and Lake Country.

Lydia Thomson, whose practice operates as Lydia H. Thomson Law Corporation, opened the firm in the summer of 2007 after years at a local firm. She graduated from the University of Saskatchewan College of Law, has practised in Kelowna for 18 years and is accredited by the Law Society of British Columbia as a family law mediator. Other services are wills and estates, committeeship and residential conveyancing, along with help for parents involved with the Ministry. Brandon is another lawyer on the team, and many referrals come from past clients.
m-j-o-nions-vancouver:
MJ O'Nions, now Stride Law, is a Vancouver firm practising family law, mediation, wills and estates and business law.

O'Nions Lawyers & Mediators, a British Columbia practice whose areas include mediation, collaborative divorce, family law agreements, wills and estates, business law and notary services. ma-adebisi-law-office-winnipeg:
MA Adebisi Law Office is a Winnipeg practice handling family law, immigration, real estate, wills and estates, and notary public services. Its family law work covers divorce, child custody, child support, spousal support and adoption. Its immigration work includes visa applications, restoration of status and permanent residency, and the notary public service covers documents for domestic or international use. The firm also handles wills and estate planning and probate, combining local knowledge with a global perspective. The office is on Provencher Boulevard.
maam-law-mississauga:
Maam Law is a Mississauga firm offering family law, wills and powers of attorney, real estate, immigration, elder abuse prevention and notarization services.

The office provides services in English, Urdu, Punjabi and Hindi, and Ms. Wadhwa works with culturally and ethnically diverse clients. Each practice area is set out in plain terms.
maana-law-mississauga:
Maana Law is a Mississauga personal injury firm handling car accidents, slip and falls, pedestrian and motorcycle injuries.

The firm has more than ten years of experience, and Aman Kalra is its lead lawyer. Its practice also covers catastrophic accidents, dog bites, public transit accidents, soft tissue and chronic pain, and long-term disability matters. Meetings can be held virtually, and home or hospital visits are possible. macdonald-zhivov-calgary:
MacDonald Zhivov is a Calgary firm that focuses on personal injury, including car accidents and slip and falls, alongside immigration, family and estate work.

The firm began in Calgary supporting people hurt in accidents and has served clients across Alberta. Its practice areas include injury law, immigration law, family law, wills and estates, and notary services. Multilingual services and personalized client care are emphasized. The firm has brought thousands of cases to resolution, and its history is one of advocacy centred on injured Albertans.
macisaac-gow-llp-oakville:
MacIsaac Gow LLP is an Oakville personal injury firm handling motor vehicle accidents, slip and fall injuries, bicycle accidents and dog bite injuries.

Its lawyers have more than 35 combined years of litigation experience, much of it working for insurance companies before acting for injured people. They have conducted trials before juries and judges across Ontario and argued matters at the highest level of court in the province. Partners Matthew C. MacIsaac and Fraser R. Gow are joined by associates Alex Robart, Mark McDonald and Maximilian Jagoda, and the firm serves clients in Mississauga and the surrounding area.
mack-lawyers:
Mack Lawyers is an Oshawa firm serving Durham Region for over 40 years in business, real estate, employment, estates and civil litigation.

Its lawyers keep up with developments in their practice areas and act for individuals, small business owners and large corporations. Corporate and commercial work includes business formation, acquisitions and mergers, financing, contracts and reorganization for corporations and sole proprietors. Family law also forms part of the firm's work, and the office is on Simcoe Street North.
mackenzie-vozza-law:
MacKenzie Vozza Law is a Sarnia practice focused on real estate, wills and estates, and corporate commercial law.

MacKenzie Vozza is an associate lawyer practising in association with George Murray Shipley Bell LLP, which she joined in May 2024. Born and raised in Sarnia, she earned a criminology degree at Western University in 2018 and a Juris Doctor at the University of Calgary in 2022, and then articled at the Provincial Court of Alberta in Edmonton, working with judges in family, civil and criminal matters. She was admitted to the Ontario Bar in 2023, and the office is at 222 Front Street North.
maclean-law-vancouver:
MacLean Law is a Vancouver family law firm handling parenting, guardianship, high net worth divorce and estate litigation matters.

The firm was founded in 1983 and has more than 43 years of practice. It has offices in Vancouver, West Vancouver, Victoria, Surrey, Kelowna and Calgary. Its areas include child parenting time, guardianship and fertility, adult guardianship, power of attorney abuse and undue influence, the division of family trusts and family businesses, and foreign child custody orders in British Columbia. Lorne MacLean, KC, Fraser MacLean, Sophie Bartholomew and Rana Yavari are co-authors of the Chambers and Partners Family Law Guide for Canada.
madaans-llp-lawyers-mississauga:
Madaans LLP is a Mississauga firm handling residential and commercial real estate and business purchases and sales across the Greater Toronto Area.

Services include sales, purchases, refinancing and title transfers, with flat-fee residential pricing plans. Service areas include Toronto, Brampton, Mississauga, Vaughan, Oakville and Hamilton. Lawyers Vikas Madaan and Simmarjit K. Madaan have practised in two jurisdictions; Vikas holds an LL.B. from the University of Victoria and articled in Nanaimo, BC. The firm intends to offer corporate, commercial, and wills and estates services as well.
maisonneuve-dawkins-lawyers:
Maisonneuve Dawkins Lawyers is a Timmins firm practising business, real estate, criminal and estates law for clients across Northeastern Ontario.

The firm continues a practice of law established in 1960 and takes a direct approach focused on getting matters resolved. Business work includes purchases and sales of businesses and commercial property, corporate governance, directors' liability and Aboriginal and Indigenous business issues. Luc Maisonneuve was admitted to the Bar in 1994 after graduating from the University of Ottawa and has pleaded before the Ontario Court of Justice, the Superior Court of Justice and the Court of Appeal for Ontario. Ben Dawkins and Renee Maisonneuve are also on the team, and the firm uses the French title Avocats.
malina-a-roshan-mississauga:
Malina Roshan runs Roshan Law, a Mississauga practice handling family and divorce law as well as criminal defence matters.

Malina Roshan founded the firm in 2010 and has more than 15 years as a family and criminal lawyer, regularly appearing in the Superior Court of Justice. The firm serves the Greater Toronto Area and communities including Brampton, Etobicoke, North York, Hamilton, Milton, Guelph, Kitchener, Waterloo, Vaughan, Newmarket, Oakville, Burlington, Oshawa and Orangeville. It offers clear pricing, regular updates on the file and a process that starts with booking a meeting.
maltais-morin-avocats:

mamann-sandaluk-llp:
Mamann Sandaluk LLP is a Toronto immigration and refugee law firm handling Canadian and American immigration matters for individuals, families and businesses.

The firm has acted in immigration cases since 1987, and its lawyers include Guidy Mamann and Joel Sandaluk. Services include Express Entry, spousal sponsorship, study and work permits, refugee protection, humanitarian applications, cross-border visas and employee transfers, and deportation defence and admissibility hearings. Its work ranges from routine applications to litigation before the Federal Court and immigration tribunals, including challenges to refusals by IRCC, CBSA and the Immigration and Refugee Board.
manbir-sodhi-brampton:
Manbir Sodhi is a Brampton criminal defence lawyer who represents people charged with offences, including impaired driving.

He practises exclusively in criminal law and offers representation at each stage, from a police request to turn oneself in through arrest, bail hearings, pre-trial and trial. Practice areas include domestic and sexual assault, weapons, drug and criminal driving offences, traffic and bylaw matters, search warrants, theft, fraud and shoplifting, youth criminal offences and professional disciplinary proceedings. The office is on George Street North in Brampton and the firm serves clients across the GTA and Ontario.
mandall-immigration-law-toronto:
Mandall Immigration Law is a Toronto firm handling visitor visas, study and work permits, spousal sponsorship, Express Entry and immigration appeals.

The firm is led by founder Austin Mandall Rooplall, who personally examines every file, and it has offices in Toronto and Ottawa. It was founded in 2024. Other services include PR card renewals, humanitarian applications, inadmissibility matters and LMIA-related work permits, and the difference between LMIA-based and exempt permits is part of its guidance. It serves clients across Canada and worldwide with a transparent, client-centred approach.
mandeep-saggi-criminal-lawyer:
Saggi Law Firm is a Brampton criminal defence practice led by Mandeep Saggi, covering bail hearings and charges before Ontario's trial courts. It is available at all hours in English and Punjabi.

Mandeep Saggi was admitted to the Ontario Bar in 2009 and practises only criminal law, appearing regularly at the Brampton Courthouse, the Ontario Court of Justice and the Superior Court of Justice. His approach is built on early preparation, including examining police disclosure and identifying weaknesses in the Crown's case. Areas served include Vaughan, Mississauga, Etobicoke, Oshawa, Newmarket, Kitchener and the wider Greater Toronto Area, and the firm also offers notarization and attestation.
mann-lawyers-llp:
Mann Lawyers LLP is a full-service Ottawa law firm with offices in Ottawa and Perth, Ontario.

The firm has advised clients for more than 25 years, and its history begins in 1994. Lawyer Heather Austin-Skaret works on estate matters, and the firm acts on employment and estate files. It has an inclusive culture and weighs the intellectual, emotional, financial and practical wellbeing of clients when seeking resolutions. Mann Lawyers also maintains an equity, diversity and inclusion committee and offers summer law student opportunities.
marc-andre-letarte-avocat-inc:
Marc-Andre Letarte, Avocat inc is a Trois-Rivieres practice that handles family law only, from separation and divorce to child custody and support.

Operating as Letarte Avocat, the practice has worked since 2006 and has represented more than a thousand clients across the province. It acts in the Superior Court on separation and divorce, and seeks judgments or negotiated settlements on child custody and parenting time, child and spousal support, division of assets and parental authority. The team includes Mathilde Milot-Beauchesne and Marc-André Letarte, with experience in litigation and pleading.
mariana-samaan-law-firm:
Mariana Samaan Law Firm is a Windsor practice handling wills and estates, real estate, contract and corporate law.

The firm works with realtors on purchases, sales, refinancing and leases, and prepares wills, powers of attorney, affidavits, contracts and agreements. Clients are served in Windsor, Essex, Tecumseh, LaSalle, Tilbury, Chatham, St. Thomas and the GTA. mark-chiu-law-kelowna:
Mark Chiu Law is a Kelowna practice handling family law and criminal law matters in the Okanagan, the Kootenays and elsewhere in British Columbia.

The lawyer behind Mark J. Chiu Law Corp, Mark Chiu, has practised in British Columbia since 2014 and holds degrees in psychology from the University of Calgary and law from the University of Saskatchewan. He has acted for the Public Prosecution Service of Canada, as defence counsel in serious matters, and in family cases involving the Family Maintenance Enforcement Program and the Ministry of Children and Family Development. Family work includes dividing property held through corporations or trusts and parenting disputes involving alienation.
mark-graham-law-office:
Mark Graham Law Office is a Guelph practice focused on real estate and mortgage law, from home purchases and sales to refinancing.

Mark Graham and his team have helped thousands of individuals and families buy, sell and refinance homes, and have also handled condominiums, commercial buildings, cottages and farms. The firm also acts for clients who lend private mortgage funds. It has two locations, in downtown Guelph and in Waterdown, and offers flexible and virtual meeting times. Mark Graham's background includes work in the pharmaceutical industry, as a political assistant to a provincial cabinet minister and as chief of staff to a Toronto councillor before law school.
marshall-law:
Marshall Law is a Toronto firm representing people in employment, human rights, harassment and sexual assault matters against employers, unions and governments.

The lawyers are Rebecca Curcio, Chase Frazer, Michelle Palmeri and Amrit Sohi, and their work includes wrongful termination, constructive dismissal and executive compensation. Intake starts with a support team member who gathers key information, followed by a one-hour or thirty-minute meeting with a lawyer, held over Zoom or in person depending on the case. The process is confidential, and the firm crafts a strategy tailored to each client. It also works beyond Ontario.
martineau-daoust-boulianne-pelletier-avo:
Martineau Daoust Boulianne Pelletier Avocats is a Rouyn-Noranda firm doing civil, business and family law and mediation.

Éric Daoust handles civil law, business law, hidden defects, bankruptcy and insolvency and mediation, while Michel-Etienne Parayre handles family law and mediation.
mast-avocats-quebec:
MAST Avocats is a Quebec City firm focused on family and youth law, with further work in immigration, criminal law and housing. It analyses each situation strategically from the first exchange, with clear explanations and determined advocacy.

For employers, the firm helps with hiring foreign workers, including labour market impact assessments under the Temporary Foreign Worker Program, international mobility exemptions, the employer portal and representation during ESDC inspections. It also advises on how criminal convictions, family matters or administrative issues can affect an immigration file, and on complaints to the United Nations Human Rights Council. Tenants and landlords are served on leases, repairs and evictions, and the office is on Boulevard des Galeries.
mat-schwartz-criminal-law-winnipeg:
Mat Schwartz Criminal Law is a Winnipeg practice limited to criminal defence, covering drug, violent, domestic and impaired driving charges. Mat Schwartz practises only criminal law and has appeared at all levels of court in Manitoba, handling matters in Winnipeg and across the province.

Drug cases range from simple possession to large-scale trafficking, often involving search warrants, surveillance and wiretaps, and evidence may be excluded at trial where police rules are broken. The practice also covers domestic and violent offences, including sexual assault allegations, and drinking and driving charges. A 24-hour line staffed by a student on duty handles urgent custody situations. The office is at 155 Carlton Street.
matthew-feehan-estate-lawyer-edmonton:
Matthew Feehan Estate Lawyer is an Edmonton practice dealing with wills, probate and estate administration.

F.M. (Ned) Feehan QC, Mark E. Feehan and Matthew F. Feehan are the lawyers, and the practice serves clients across Canada from offices in Alberta and British Columbia. Its guidance covers what probate is and when it is required, how applications and grants of administration work, why a person should have a will and what naming an executor involves.
matthew-gould-criminal-law-winnipeg:
Matthew Gould Criminal Law is a Winnipeg practice defending impaired driving, domestic violence, drug, assault and fraud charges across Manitoba.

Matt Gould is an associate at Brodsky & Company Barristers, a Winnipeg criminal defence firm, alongside G. Greg Brodsky, Q.C. He was admitted to the bar in 2008 and practises criminal defence exclusively. After business school at the University of Western Ontario and three years abroad, he returned to study law at the University of Manitoba. Other areas include sexual assault, firearm offences, theft and property offences, youth offences and white collar crime.
mawazini-visa-and-immigration-services-o:
Mawazini Visa and Immigration Services is an Ottawa consultancy assisting with refugee protection, family sponsorship, study and work permits and appeals.

It is an immigration consulting firm led by Abdullah Mawazini, a licensed consultant accredited by the Canadian College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants, with over 22 years of experience and hundreds of completed cases. Services include refugee applications and hearings, appeals of refused applications, sponsorship of spouses, parents and children, passport services, permanent residence, PR cards, visit applications, academic accreditation reports, and RCMP fingerprints and biometrics. The address is in Nepean.
maxime-lapointe-associes-inc:
Maxime Lapointe & Associés is a Quebec City boutique firm handling immigration law, mobility and international recruitment in Quebec and Canada. It has more than 13 years of experience and works from Quebec City with additional offices in Montreal and Paris.

Services include temporary and permanent residence, family reunification, business immigration, compliance and recruitment of foreign workers. The firm works with the Temporary Foreign Worker Program, International Experience Canada, the International Mobility Program, programs for self-employed workers, entrepreneurs and investors, and rehabilitation of people inadmissible to Canada. Clients include private companies, institutions, business people and individuals.
mbbm-lawyers-llp:
MBBM Lawyers LLP is a Toronto litigation firm handling commercial and civil disputes, trucking and auto litigation, accident benefits and insurance matters.

The firm acts for insurers, corporations, small businesses and individuals, with lawyers in downtown Toronto and an office in Calgary. Its areas include loss transfer and priority disputes, examinations under oath, cargo claims, property claims and coverage opinions. Its lawyers act before all levels of court in Ontario, the Licence Appeal Tribunal and private arbitrations, and are available to attend an accident scene. Recent articles discuss flawed outside reports in litigation and the case of McFee v. Sutram.
mbl-avocats-inc:
MBL Avocats is a Drummondville firm covering civil, family, youth, business and administrative law, with its main office near the courthouse.

The firm serves Drummondville and neighbouring regions, and its working methods are honesty, rigour, efficiency and pragmatism. Civil matters include estates, real estate, contracts, hidden defects and civil liability; family matters include child custody, support, divorce, paternity, filiation and adoption; youth work includes proceedings involving the DPJ. It also covers criminal law, and its articles address water runoff between neighbours, mandates of protection and the new Tribunal unifié de la famille.
mccague-borlack-llp:
McCague Borlack LLP is a Toronto litigation firm focused on insurance defence and insurance coverage, with offices in Ottawa, Kitchener, London and Barrie.

The firm has represented clients across Canada, North America and overseas since 1994, and has grown from 11 to over 50 lawyers. Its lawyers act at trials, appeals and in arbitration, mediation and negotiation, and also represent corporate and commercial entities, financial companies and individuals. The accident benefits group advises on loss transfer, priority disputes between insurers and work-related injuries. The firm publishes case commentary on Ontario court decisions about insurer priority and out-of-province medical expenses.

McCrea Immigration Law is a Vancouver firm advising on work permits, permanent residence, citizenship and corporate immigration.

mcelderry-morris:
McElderry & Morris is a general practice law firm in Guelph covering property, family and litigation matters from its office on Woolwich Street.

A receptionist greets visitors, and limited street parking is available nearby.
mcelroy-law-ottawa:
McElroy Law is an Ottawa criminal defence firm acting for people charged with offences, from bail hearings through trials and appeals.

Anne-Marie McElroy founded the firm in 2015, and associate Dawn Dickinson has since joined. Anne-Marie graduated from the University of Ottawa law school in 2009, was admitted to the bar in 2010 and has practised criminal law exclusively since. Her experience includes impaired driving, assault, theft and sexual offences. Outside the firm she supervises Pro Bono Students Canada projects, sits on the board of Circles of Support and Accountability, has taught first-year criminal law at the University of Ottawa, and mentors women in criminal defence. The firm also maintains a blog on new cases and legislation.
mcintosh-and-zayed-s-r-l-winnipeg:
In Winnipeg, McIntosh & Zayed s.r.l., a local firm, handles immigration, real estate, business and wills and estates matters.

Its immigration work covers refugee matters, applications and appeals, and the real estate group acts on purchases, sales and developments, walking Manitoba buyers through the costs and paperwork. The business group deals with corporations, contracts and litigation, while the wills and estates group handles wills, powers of attorney and probate. The firm uses custom technology to help clients put their testamentary documents in order, and it also offers notary public appointments. It aims to bring clients peace of mind.
mckenzie-lake-lawyers-llp:
McKenzie Lake Lawyers LLP is a London, Ontario firm with a Guelph office, serving Southwestern Ontario in business, family, injury and estate law.

The firm was founded in 1998 in London through the merger of two firms with roots in the 1930s. mclaren-bryan-law-professional-corporati:
McLaren Bryan Law is a Peterborough practice handling residential and commercial real estate, immigration, wills and estates, and family law.

Chantal McLaren Bryan is the founder and principal lawyer, and the team brings over 14 years of legal experience across several practice areas. Real estate work covers acquisitions, dispositions, financing and leasing. Immigration work includes applications, sponsorships and status matters for individuals and families, while estate services include planning, administration and litigation. mclennan-ross-llp:
McLennan Ross LLP is an Edmonton firm acting for corporations, governments and public bodies in employment, municipal and litigation matters. The firm works from a base in Alberta and the Northwest Territories for clients across Canada, including not-for-profit organizations.

mcnally-gervan-lawyers-llp-ottawa:

McNally Gervan represents individuals across Eastern Ontario and serves Ontario generally.
mcquarrie:
McQuarrie is a Surrey multi-practice law firm handling business law, land development, insurance denials and estates for clients since 1967.

Its main office is in the Central City Tower in downtown Surrey, with meeting space in Burnaby and Vancouver by appointment, and it serves businesses, individuals and institutions across the Lower Mainland, the Fraser Valley and British Columbia. The firm sponsors community causes and gives to charity. Its practice areas also include family law, and its articles cover injurious affection, resulting trusts and British Columbia's prompt payment law for the construction industry.

McTague Law Firm LLP is a Windsor firm founded in 1920, handling corporate, commercial and civil litigation, employment and estates matters.

McTague practised with the firm until his 1935 appointment to the Supreme Court of Ontario; he joined the Court of Appeal for Ontario in 1938 and later chaired the National Labour Relations Board. The firm practises corporate and commercial, commercial litigation, civil litigation, employment and labour, estates and trusts, commercial real estate and privacy law, and runs an articling program for students.
md-law-group-edmonton:
MD Law Group is an Edmonton firm handling criminal defence, family law, civil litigation, employment and personal injury matters across Alberta.

Its Calgary family law work covers divorce, child custody and support, spousal support, property division and cohabitation agreements. The firm also publishes articles on rights during a police encounter in Alberta, assault charges, what to expect at a criminal trial and recent legal reforms.

meighen-haddad-llp-brandon:
Meighen Haddad LLP is a Brandon, Manitoba firm serving Western Manitoba in real estate, corporate and commercial law, wills and estates, and family law.

menneh-legal-s-a:
Menneh Legal is a bilingual Montreal firm advising businesses and individuals on business law, litigation, civil law and commercial real estate. It also handles finance and lending work for borrowers and lenders, and trademark disputes over brand names, logos and trade dress, across Quebec.

menon-b-droit-des-arts:
MENON B is a Sherbrooke arts law practice handling contracts and business matters for musicians, performers and cultural businesses. The lawyer works exclusively for artists, creators and cultural enterprises in the music industry and the performing arts, in Quebec and internationally.

merchant-law-group-llp-surrey:
Merchant Law Group LLP is a Surrey firm offering personal injury, family, criminal and class action representation, among other practice areas.

merovitz-potechin-llp-ottawa:
Merovitz Potechin LLP is an Ottawa firm serving personal and business clients in litigation, business law, real estate, and wills and estates.

metro-law-office:
Metro Law Office LLP is a Burnaby firm of lawyers and notaries public handling real estate, family law, wills, estates, corporate matters and immigration.

meunier-carrier-lawyers:
Meunier Carrier Lawyers is a boutique civil litigation firm in Timmins focused on personal injury, including motor vehicle accidents and slip-and-fall cases.

The office is on Second Avenue.
mg-law-personal-injury-lawyers-ottawa:
MG Law is an Ottawa personal injury firm handling car accident, catastrophic injury and insurance matters.

mian-hakeem-law-professional-corporation:
Mian Hakeem Law Professional Corporation is a Mississauga firm focused on real estate and immigration, with corporate and family law work.

michael-a-wills-windsor:
Michael Wills is a Windsor lawyer advising employers and employees on employment law, labour law and litigation, with real estate work as well.

Employment topics include wrongful dismissal, employment contracts, human rights advice, workplace investigations and Employment Standards Act compliance. Clients across Ontario can be served in employment, labour and real estate law, with plain-language advice and upfront discussion of process, timelines and cost.
michael-dibua-law-prof-corp-brampton:
Michael Dibua Law Prof Corp., based in Brampton, handles family law and civil litigation, including divorce, separation and support.

Michael Dibua obtained his law degree at Obafemi Awolowo University in Nigeria in 1997, was admitted to the Nigerian Bar in 1999 and completed a master's degree in law at Cardiff University in 2004. Before opening the practice he worked as in-house counsel in banking, handling debt collection, litigation and risk matters.
