Areas of law include Calgary family, divorce and employment matters, civil litigation, construction disputes and protection orders, and the firm also handles wills and estates and refugee law. It supports individuals, families and businesses across Calgary and Alberta, drawing on business experience and a collaborative approach that favours negotiation and efficient dispute resolution before litigation. Its blog covers Alberta topics such as parenting after separation, property division and child and spousal support.
oracle-law-vancouver:
Oracle Law is a Vancouver firm handling real estate conveyancing, mortgage refinancing and corporate law, with flat-fee residential purchase and sale work.

Work includes residential and strata purchases, commercial property purchases, family transfers and gifted property, and subdivisions. Lawyer Peter has more than ten years of experience, has run his own firm, and works alongside clients' accountants, mortgage brokers and realtors when issues arise. He is fluent in Greek and serves clients in both English and Greek, and he is involved in the Greek Community of Greater Vancouver. Pricing is transparent and advice is practical.
osborne-law-group-st-catharines:
Osborne Law Group focuses on Ontario probate applications, estate administration and wills, alongside real estate and corporate law, for Niagara residents.

Based at 5 Race Street in St. Catharines, the firm has over 17 years of practice and has served more than 3,500 clients across its practice areas. Its work covers Certificates of Appointment of Estate Trustee with and without a will, Small Estate Certificates for estates under $150,000, and the situations where a bank, investment firm or purchaser may ask for probate. Stephen Osborne is its probate and estate lawyer, and fixed-fee options exist for eligible probate applications.
osler-hoskin-harcourt-llp:
Osler, Hoskin & Harcourt LLP is a Toronto business law firm with offices across Canada and in New York.

The firm has more than 500 lawyers and over 160 years in Canadian business law, working through an integrated network of offices in Toronto, Montréal, Calgary, Ottawa, Vancouver and New York. Matters include acting for Shell in its acquisition of ARC Resources, Amazon in its inaugural maple bond offering, Anthem Entertainment in the sale of its music catalog, and the Ontario government in an investment in Scarborough Junction LP. An interdisciplinary team advises pipeline companies on energy infrastructure projects.
osler-hoskin-harcourt-llp-calgary:
Osler, Hoskin & Harcourt LLP is a business law firm with a Calgary office in Brookfield Place, handling energy and corporate and M&A matters. It has offices in Toronto, Montréal, Calgary, Ottawa, Vancouver and New York, a team of over 500 lawyers, and more than 160 years of business law practice.

An interdisciplinary team advises pipeline companies on energy infrastructure projects, and client work includes Shell's $22-billion acquisition of ARC Resources, Emera's combination with Canadian Utilities and ATCO, and Amazon's $14-billion maple bond offering. Its insights cover federal project-approval legislation, tariffs and tax measures, and the firm works as a single firm across its offices.
osra-avocats-laval:
Osra Avocats is a Laval, Quebec, firm working mainly in family law across the greater Montreal region.

Matters include contested and amicable divorces, separation, negotiated settlements, child custody, child and spousal support, changes to support orders, partition of the family patrimony and the partnership of acquests, safeguard measures and loss of parental authority. Family law rests above all on human and psychological considerations, so each file is handled with attention to the client's needs and expectations, with an emphasis on listening. Lawyer Me Wafa Ouafi is part of the team.
osuji-and-smith-employment-lawyers-calga:
Osuji & Smith is a Calgary firm handling employment and labour law, business and corporate advisory work, family law and real estate.

The firm was founded in 1980 and re-envisioned in 2017, and it now has a presence in Vancouver, Toronto and Dubai. Employment work covers executive exits, wrongful dismissal and workplace investigations for both employers and employees. The team speaks more than 32 languages and includes Dr. Charles Osuji, James (Jim) Smith and Phil Lalonde. Civil litigation and estate planning are also among its areas, and the firm takes part in community and professional initiatives.
pace-law-firm:
Pace Law Firm is an Etobicoke multi-service firm acting in personal injury, immigration, family, real estate, criminal and employment law.

The firm was established in 1981 and now has more than 160 legal professionals in four offices serving clients in over 38 languages. It serves Toronto and the rest of Ontario, with flexible meeting times and multilingual service. Its practice areas also include corporate and commercial law and litigation. Through an initiative called Pace Cares, the firm supports community groups, including a Scarborough organization that provides food access to local families.
pacific-legal-professional-corporation-t:
Pacific Legal is a Toronto corporate and commercial firm handling incorporations, shareholder agreements, acquisitions and real estate.

The firm was founded in 2021 by Avi Khanna, who worked at Toronto corporate firms on mergers and financings before starting it. Yash Mehrotra is also on the team. Work includes start-up representation, asset purchase agreements, creditors' rights, contracts, shareholder and partnership agreements, buy-sell agreements, franchise matters and commercial technology transactions. It serves clients across Ontario in technology, real estate, e-commerce and professional services, from incorporation through to exit.
pacific-point-law-corporation-surrey:
Pacific Point Law Corporation is a Surrey firm covering family law, immigration and refugee matters, real estate, wills and estates, and business law.

Further areas include corporate services, intellectual property, civil disputes and criminal defence, and the firm serves Surrey, White Rock, Delta, Langley, Cloverdale and Metro Vancouver. The office sits minutes from the Peace Arch border crossing, stays open until 7 PM on weekdays, and offers appointments in English, Hindi, Urdu, Punjabi and ASL. A second office in Kelowna operates by appointment, and the firm notes a successful PRRA decision for a client facing removal.
parlatore-law-niagara-niagara-falls: Parlatore Law handles personal injury cases and residential real estate transactions for clients in Niagara Falls and across the Niagara Region. Its lawyers act for people in Niagara Falls and surrounding communities, with personal injury and real estate as practice areas. Clients pay no fees if there is no recovery, and each case is treated as unique to the individual. The office is at 6387 Morrison Street, Suite 200, in Niagara Falls, Ontario.
parlee-mclaws-llp:
Parlee McLaws LLP is a regional Alberta firm with offices in Edmonton and Calgary, advising on corporate and litigation matters.

The firm has operated for more than 125 years and is a large, multi-service practice. It takes a team approach drawn from its range of service areas, acting for local, national and international clients across a variety of industries. Services include intellectual property protection, patent licensing, non-disclosure agreements and trade secrets, and its news covers employer privacy questions raised by Alberta's new driver's licences and identification cards. The Edmonton office is in the Enbridge Centre on 101 Street.
parr-business-law-vancouver:
Parr Business Law is a Vancouver firm handling incorporations, contracts, business sales and purchases, wills and estate planning.

Services include incorporations and corporate reorganizations, contract drafting, and help with buying and selling a business or planning succession. The estate side covers wills, powers of attorney, healthcare representation agreements, corporate wills, alter ego and joint partner trusts, estate freezes, and probate administration with executor support. Estate planning and wills in Vancouver, including trusts, executors and the probate process in British Columbia, are covered in detail.
passgo-real-estate-law-calgary:
PassGo Real Estate Law is a Calgary firm that closes home purchases, sales, mortgage refinances and title transfers through an online workspace or in person.

The firm acts on properties in Alberta and British Columbia. Clients upload documents, meet with a lawyer online or face to face, and then collect keys or receive funds. For title changes, it prepares the transfer, coordinates mortgage requirements and files with Alberta Land Titles. The team includes Erin Crocker, who has over ten years of practice, along with Shivam Parekh, Amy Kim, Cari Henschel, Denyse Giguere, Anthony Staddon, Emily Johnston and Kaiya Proulx.
passi-patel:
Passi & Patel is a Brampton criminal defence firm that handles charges ranging from mischief and shoplifting to drug and weapons offences. The firm practises only criminal law and works throughout Ontario.

Jay Passi is a Peel region lawyer with more than twenty-three years in criminal law, and Rick Patel is the firm's other lawyer. Its assault material sets out the definition in section 265 of the Criminal Code of Canada and notes that a charge can arise from attempted or threatened force as well as actual force. The office is on County Court Boulevard in Brampton.
patel-law-firm:
Patel Law Firm is a Brampton practice handling family law, civil litigation, criminal matters and wills and estates across the Greater Toronto Area. The downtown office is on Queen Street East in Brampton.

Mikesh H. Patel practises family and civil litigation and also sits as a mediator in family, estate and property disputes, as well as contract, financial, ownership and business disagreements. He holds a Juris Doctor from the University of Ottawa. Sonal H. Patel is an Ontario barrister and solicitor and a member of the Peel Law Association and the Criminal Lawyers' Association, practising criminal and family litigation.
pathfinder-law-abbotsford:
Pathfinder Law is an Abbotsford firm handling family law, divorce, civil litigation, construction, employment, wills and business matters.

Founder Timothy S. Bhullar has appeared in the Supreme Court of British Columbia, the Provincial Court and the British Columbia Court of Appeal, as well as before administrative tribunals. The firm serves families in Abbotsford, Langley, Chilliwack and surrounding areas on divorce, child and spousal support, custody and property division, and serves all of British Columbia. Construction work includes builders' lien and delay matters.
pathway-legal-family-lawyers:
Pathway Legal Family Lawyers is a Victoria family law firm guiding families across British Columbia through separation, divorce and related conflict.

The firm structures its service around what it calls the P.A.T.H. method, an acronym for practical, action-oriented and heart-centred values, with a step-by-step process that starts with reaching out and sharing what matters most. It serves families in Victoria, Nanaimo, Vancouver and Surrey as well as province-wide, and refers to its staff as the Pathway Legal Pack. The Victoria office is on Wale Road.
pav-singh-criminal-lawyer-mississauga:
Pav Singh is a Mississauga criminal defence lawyer who represents clients across Peel Region, Toronto and surrounding areas.

Pav Singh completed a Bachelor of Arts in Criminal Justice at Ryerson University, a law degree at the University of Leicester, and a Master of Laws at Osgoode Hall Law School. His personal line is answered around the clock, every day of the year, and evening, weekend and out-of-office meetings are available. Fees are quoted upfront, with block fee and hourly options and payment plans. His office is on Matheson Boulevard West in Mississauga, Ontario.
pelsmakher-law-toronto:
Pelsmakher Law is a Toronto employment and labour firm acting for employees and employers on dismissal, human rights and contract matters.

Founder Simon Pelsmakher also advises on executive compensation, privacy, occupational health and safety, and pensions and benefits. For employees, work includes severance assessment and negotiation, employment contract analysis, employment standards issues such as unpaid wages and overtime, pregnancy and parental leave, and termination rules for federally regulated employees under the Canada Labour Code. For employers it helps manage workplace risk and policies. Acting for both sides shapes the firm's strategy, and clients deal directly with their lawyer.
pender-litigation-vancouver:
Pender Litigation is a Vancouver criminal defence firm covering driving, sexual and violent offences in British Columbia courts.

The firm's lawyers have also acted as ad hoc prosecutors, which lets them see cases from both sides. Its work spans minor offences, large complex cases, appeals and related applications. Driving law is a cornerstone of the practice, with attention to the strict time limits that apply to challenges involving driving privileges. Pender Litigation examines the evidence in detail, guides clients through how the justice system works, and takes a collaborative, team-based approach to each case.
perley-robertson-hill-and-mcdougall-llp:
Perley-Robertson, Hill & McDougall LLP is an independent Ottawa firm handling business and corporate law, real estate, litigation and employment matters.

Founded in Ottawa in 1971, the firm marked its 50th anniversary in 2021. It speaks to clients in plain language, keeps in regular touch and tries to learn each client's goals and business objectives. Alternative dispute resolution, including mediation and arbitration, is among its services. Recent news includes an Ontario Court of Appeal ruling on termination clauses and the promotion of Brian Kells to partner. The firm also supports the local community in the National Capital Region, including pro bono work for organizations and individuals.
perrin-ahmad-llp:
Perrin Ahmad LLP is a North Bay litigation firm handling criminal defence, family law, civil litigation, and wills, trusts and probate.

The firm's practice regularly takes it before trial courts in Ontario, and its lawyers appear in courts across the province from an office on the shore of Lake Nipissing. Its approach is principled, centred on Canada's Charter of Rights and Freedoms and on helping clients through a government-administered system. Family law work includes divorce, child custody and spousal support. The office is on Algonquin Avenue.
phillips-aiello-winnipeg:
Phillips Aiello is a Winnipeg firm handling criminal litigation, civil litigation and family proceedings, founded by David Phillips and Joe Aiello.

David Phillips earned his law degree at the University of Manitoba in 1986, has been managing partner since 1990, and has practised criminal and child protection law since 1986, including appearances before the Supreme Court of Canada. Joe Aiello, a founding partner, handles general civil litigation, administrative law, employment matters for employers and employees, and tax litigation such as PST and GST collections. He has appeared in Provincial Court, Federal Court Trial Division and the Tax Court of Canada, among other courts.
pihl-law-corporation-kelowna:
Pihl Law Corporation is a Kelowna litigation firm covering commercial litigation, personal injury, construction, family and estate disputes, and employment law.

The firm also offers mediation services and is a dispute resolution practice built on a team approach. Sean Pihl, K.C., is among the lawyers, alongside Andrew Prior, Alexander Spraggs, Calen Janzen, Connor Elliott, Emily Bowen and Avery Barnett. The firm walks clients through the legal process, gives them a candid view of their case, and will refer a client to another professional when that serves them better. Its articles discuss toxic torts and commercial leases.
pioneer-law-corporation:
Pioneer Law Corporation is a Burnaby firm handling real estate, corporate law and business transactions for clients in Burnaby and Vancouver.

The firm was founded in 2014 to help individuals, families and businesses pursue new opportunities, whether buying or selling a home, starting a business or planning ahead. Its name reflects the idea of a pioneer opening new paths, and its core values are integrity, clarity and excellence. Tiffany C.H. Pang is part of the team, and English and Korean are offered.
pkf-lawyers-winnipeg:
PKF Lawyers is a Winnipeg firm with locations across Manitoba, tracing its history to 1924 and acting for entrepreneurs, families and farms.

Nathan Bernard Golsof founded the firm in Winnipeg in 1924, and Gordon Pullan, Q.C., joined in 1951. A June 1954 fire destroyed the Time Building on Portage Avenue where the firm rented offices, after which it moved to the Newport Centre. In 2003 the partners bought the former Leatherdale Funeral premises. The firm is a Manitoba-wide practice that handles essential legal services for a wide variety of clients.
point-legal: Point Legal is a Laval criminal defence practice at 3505 Boulevard Saint-Martin Ouest, Suite 202, Laval, Quebec. It appears in the Réseau des professionnels du droit du Québec directory as a criminal law lawyer in Laval. No further information about its lawyers, services or approach is available for this profile, so the entry is limited to its name, city, practice area and address.
poliquin-karine: Poliquin Karine is a Sherbrooke criminal defence practice at 390 Rue King Ouest, Sherbrooke, Quebec. It appears in the Réseau des professionnels du droit du Québec directory as Raymond Poliquin Avocats, criminal and penal law in Sherbrooke. No further information about its lawyers, services or approach is available for this profile, so the entry is limited to its name, city, practice area and address.
pollack-tsimerman-llp-north-york:
Pollack Tsimerman LLP is a North York personal injury firm whose lawyers have worked on both the plaintiff and insurance sides of injury litigation.

The team includes Philip Pollack, Ziv Tsimerman, Lianne Sharvit, Michelle Farb, Julie Koritar, Laura Barbosa, Luca Drago and Ayla Koritar. Pollack, a graduate of Western University and Osgoode Hall Law School, formerly practised civil litigation at a large Toronto firm acting for national and international insurers. His injury work centres on motor vehicle and snowmobile accidents, slip and falls, long-term disability, product liability and sport and recreational litigation, and he appears before the Ontario Superior Court of Justice. The firm is prepared to take cases to trial.
pollock-company-lawyers-winnipeg:
Pollock & Company Lawyers is a Winnipeg firm handling medical malpractice, personal injury, criminal law and civil litigation, plus notary services.

The firm was founded in 1960 by Harvey I. Pollock, Q.C. His son Martin J. Pollock joined in 1985, followed by grandson Noah M. Globerman in 2014 and Ethan J. Pollock in 2017. Its work covers people injured through health care negligence, slip and fall incidents and wrongful death, as well as defence of charges under the Criminal Code of Canada. Civil litigation covers contractual disputes, property ownership or damage, estate litigation and insurance disputes.
porcelli-d-angela-llp-mississauga:
Porcelli D'Angela LLP is a Mississauga personal injury firm handling motor vehicle accidents, bicycle accidents and long-term disability matters.

Vince Porcelli and Tullio A. D'Angela bring over 50 years of combined legal experience. Vince is a senior licensed paralegal in Ontario who has worked on motor vehicle accident benefit matters for over 25 years, and Tullio is the firm's lawyer. The firm helps clients understand their rights and what to expect during a lawsuit, and no fees are owed unless money is recovered on an injury or disability matter.
portfolio-estate-law-etobicoke:
Portfolio Estate Law is an Etobicoke firm handling tax and estate planning, estate administration and fiduciary services for international clients.

Founder Birute Luksenaite holds a law degree from Queen's University and arts degrees from the University of Toronto, and articled at the Tax Court of Canada. She later worked in tax law at a national firm, a global accounting firm and a bank. The firm handles powers of attorney, family, spousal and alter ego trusts, estate freezes and beneficiary designations, offers tax and succession planning for artists' estates, and assists vulnerable persons.
ppd-law-office-brandon:
PPD Law Office is a boutique Brandon firm handling real estate, business, immigration, family and estate matters for Manitoba clients. It serves individuals, families, professionals and business owners across Manitoba.

Practice areas are real estate law, business and corporate law, civil law, wills and estate law, immigration law and family law. Real estate work includes buying, selling and leasing property, and family work includes divorce and child custody. The firm is a boutique practice built around personalized service, and the office is at 217 10th Street in Brandon.
preferred-immigration-services-edmonton:
Preferred Immigration Services is an Edmonton immigration consulting practice assisting with work permits, Express Entry, LMIA and sponsorship.

It also covers permanent residence. Carl Wurfel is director, and its consultants have worked in the field for over ten years. The firm handles study permits and spousal sponsorship and acts for individuals, families and employers. It serves Edmonton, Sherwood Park, St. Albert, Spruce Grove, Stony Plain, Leduc and surrounding Alberta communities, and many clients come through referrals from friends and family.
prelia-canada-montreal: Prelia Canada (Montreal) is a Montreal legal practice with corporate and commercial law as its practice areas. It presents itself as Prelia, Legal Partners, and its office is at 1080 Côte du Beaver Hall, Suite 2100, Montreal, Quebec. No further details about its lawyers or services are available for this profile, so the entry is limited to its name, city, practice areas and address.
prelia-canada-quebec: Prelia Canada (Quebec) is a legal practice in Quebec City, Quebec, presenting itself as Prelia, Legal Partners. Its office is at 580 Grande Allée Est, Suite 400, Quebec City. No practice areas are recorded for this location and no further details are available, so this entry is limited to its name, place and address.
preszler-injury-lawyers:
Preszler Injury Lawyers is a Vancouver personal injury firm with an office at 1075 West Georgia Street, Unit 825.

The directory lists the practice under personal injury in Vancouver, British Columbia. No details about its lawyers, services, languages or approach are available for this profile. Further information should be taken from the firm directly.
pringle-law-edmonton:
Pringle Law is an Edmonton criminal defence firm representing people charged with criminal and regulatory offences across Western Canada.

Criminal defence is the only area every one of the firm's lawyers practises. Offences handled range from driving offences and domestic violence to sexual offences and weapons offences, at every stage from arrest and bail hearings to sentencing, trials and appeals. The firm also takes administrative offences, and its service area includes British Columbia and the Northwest Territories. The lawyers include Dan Chivers, Michael D. Sparks and the late Alexander Pringle, K.C. (1947-2015), and the firm offers an extradition guide and an articling student program.
property-law-firm-cb-llp-calgary:
Property Law Firm CB LLP is a Calgary real estate practice handling home purchases, sales, refinancing and ownership transfers.

The firm is a purpose-built real estate practice serving clients across Canada, with offices in Alberta and Ontario. It guides people from home purchases through to complex lending agreements, using remote closings and digital documentation to limit delays. Realtors, lenders and title companies are the professionals it works with, and its focus is heading off legal issues before a closing. Its mission is to change how real estate is transacted nationally.
protomanni-associates:
Protomanni & Associates handles criminal, family, employment, civil litigation, wills and real estate matters in St. Catharines.

The firm also handles Highway Traffic Act offences and immigration law. David Protomanni leads the criminal division and practises alongside Sarah Kohut, who also practises only criminal defence. Family services include separation agreements, marriage contracts, cohabitation agreements, divorce, mediation, foreign divorce opinion letters, independent legal advice and Children's Aid Society matters in Niagara, and Legal Aid is accepted for some family cases. A senior employment lawyer acts for both employees and companies throughout Ontario. The office is on Church Street.
provenzano-law:
Provenzano Law advises on business, wills and estate matters in Sault Ste. Marie, a family practice founded in 1969 by Frank Provenzano.

The firm has served Sault Ste. Marie and Northern Ontario for more than five decades. Frank Provenzano has practised alongside his brother Carmen, who was the city's Member of Parliament from 1997 to 2004, and his son Christian, who took responsibility for the firm on January 1, 2009 and served as the city's mayor from 2015 to 2022. Frank continues to practise and mentors junior lawyers. The practice addresses questions about incorporating, holding corporations, passing on a family business and estate trustee disputes.
purves-smith-law-guelph:
Purves-Smith Law is a Guelph family law practice serving Guelph and Kitchener-Waterloo on custody, support, property and child protection matters.

Lawyer Michael D. Purves-Smith, an Osgoode Hall Law School graduate who received the Morden prize in Evidence Law, focuses on high-conflict and complex files. The work covers custody disputes, guideline child support, imputation of income, property equalization involving business, corporate and farm assets, pensions, occupation rent, domestic contracts, and Children's Aid Society matters. The firm also offers mediated settlement of family issues and accepts Legal Aid certificates case by case. Michael Purves-Smith is both a family and criminal lawyer.
pushor-mitchell-llp:
Pushor Mitchell LLP is a Kelowna full-service firm handling business law, real estate, personal injury and family law across the Okanagan and beyond.

The firm has served Kelowna for over 50 years and acts for clients in Penticton, Vernon, Summerland, Kamloops and Prince George. It is the Official Law Firm of the Kelowna Rockets and works with students at UBC Okanagan. In medical malpractice, Paul Mitchell, K.C. has settled serious medical malpractice and birth injury cases involving British Columbia and Alberta doctors, clinicians and hospitals.
r-a-cooper-professional-corporation:
R A Cooper Professional Corporation is a Kitchener firm led by Richard Cooper, handling real estate, wills and estates, and corporate law.

Richard Cooper was admitted to the bar in 1976, studied at York University and Osgoode Hall, and articled in Toronto before moving to Kitchener in 1977. He has taught at Conestoga College, given seminars to the Kitchener-Waterloo Real Estate Board and written a weekly real estate law column in the Waterloo Region Record. Services include mortgages, agreements of purchase and sale, easements, wills, powers of attorney, estate administration, incorporations, shareholder agreements and notary services.
rana-u-hameed-criminal-law-mississauga:
Criminal defence lawyer Umer Hameed leads Rana U Hameed Criminal Law in Mississauga, defending people charged with offences across Ontario.

The firm handles offences against the person, sexual and weapons offences, driving and drug offences, property and financial offences, and bail hearings at both the Ontario Court of Justice and the Superior Court of Justice. Umer Hameed holds BScN, LL.B. and LL.M. degrees, articled at a boutique Toronto defence firm and later worked as an associate at another Toronto criminal firm. His experience includes matters before the Ontario Court of Justice, the Superior Court of Justice and the Court of Appeal for Ontario, and flexible payment plans are available.
randhawa-law-centre-surrey:
Randhawa Law Centre is a Surrey, BC law office and notary practice handling real estate, family law, and wills and estates for the Lower Mainland.

The firm was founded by Honveer Randhawa, who earned his law degree at the University of Manitoba, and it serves clients in English, Punjabi and Hindi. Its work includes divorce, builder's liens, property sales and purchases, refinancing, mortgage conveyancing, certificates of pending litigation and notary services, with immigration also handled. The office keeps late weekday hours, is available on weekends when needed, and welcomes walk-ins at its ground-floor location on 80 Avenue.
randy-ai-law-office-toronto:
Randy Ai Law Office is a Toronto employment law practice handling severance, wrongful dismissal and workplace harassment matters.

The firm was founded in 2014 by Randy Ai and acts for both employees and employers across Ontario. Its areas include labour law, human rights, disability law, employment litigation and class actions, and it works under the Employment Standards Act, the Canada Labour Code and the Ontario Human Rights Code. The firm has represented more than 10,000 clients and offers evening and weekend appointments. Randy Ai appears on CTV News and writes for the Globe and Mail.
randy-norris-mississauga:
Randy Norris is a Mississauga criminal defence lawyer and former Crown Attorney who defends serious charges in Mississauga, Brampton and Peel Region.

A graduate of Osgoode Hall Law School, he began as a Crown Attorney in 1994 and moved into private practice in 1999. He regularly defends sexual assault, domestic assault, child pornography, theft and fraud, youth matters and impaired driving charges. He also advises people who have just been charged on release conditions, bail terms and disclosure. His office is in Mississauga, and he serves Mississauga, Brampton and the wider province of Ontario.
rathore-baig-professional-corporation:
Rathore Baig Professional Corporation is a Markham real estate law office handling purchases, sales, leases and related disputes. The practice is limited to real estate rather than general law.

Services include negotiating terms, conditions, representations and warranties, reviewing contracts and status certificates, and registering transfers, deeds, charges and discharges. The firm also drafts agreements, deals with settlement and litigation, and covers evictions, rent increases and notices, as well as commercial lease agreements. Its closings number more than 7,000, and it offers a library of informational videos. The office is on Markham Road in Markham.
rdm-lawyers-llp:
RDM Lawyers LLP is an Abbotsford full-service firm handling business law, real estate, estate planning, employment and divorce matters in the Fraser Valley.

The firm has been community-based since 1971 and serves families, homeowners, business owners and organizations, with legal services in Langley, Abbotsford, Mission and Chilliwack. Lawyers Ravi Duhra and Ishpreet Rai handle business law, commercial lending and real estate, Sheri Yakashiro handles business law, real estate and wills, Jessie Legaree handles civil litigation, employment and estate litigation, and Kam Grewal handles estate planning and commercial lending.
real-estate-lawyers-ca-llp-mississauga:
Real Estate Lawyers LLP is a Mississauga-based firm handling home purchases, sales, mortgage refinancing and title transfers for clients across Ontario.

The firm operates from more than 30 locations and charges flat-rate fees with no retainer taken up front. Closing documents can be signed by remote video from 7am to midnight, seven days a week, or through in-home mobile signing. It works with real estate agents, lenders, private lenders and title insurers, and offers services for first-time homebuyers and clients with special needs. Title transfers it handles include family gifts, adding a spouse and estate transfers.
rebibo-legal:
Rebibo Legal is a Montreal immigration law boutique handling visas, permanent residence, citizenship and family sponsorship for people moving to Canada.

The firm covers more than 100 options, including Express Entry, family sponsorship and temporary visas, along with Quebec immigration, study pathways to permanent residence and the Provincial Nominee Programs. Immigration lawyer Joseph Rebibo leads the practice, and the firm is available on WhatsApp. Canada has over 50 permanent resident visa types plus about 30 further pathways, so choosing the right one is a central step. The office is at 1168 Sainte-Catherine West, Suite 203.
red-booth-law-toronto:
Red Booth Law is a Toronto-area estates practice handling estate litigation, probate, wills, trusts and powers of attorney across Ontario.

The litigation side covers disputes over estate administration, the passing of estate trustee accounts, conflicts among beneficiaries, undue influence, upholding or challenging a will, and dependant's relief. The firm also deals with probate and the appointment of estate trustees, and a Certificate of Appointment typically issues within two to three months. Guardianship appointments and living trusts are handled as well, and the firm publishes plain-language guides on the Ontario estate administration tax and on guardianship. The office is in Scarborough.
reich-law-calgary:
Reich Law is a Calgary real estate firm handling commercial and residential property work, including foreclosure, restrictive covenants and related litigation.

The firm was founded and is based in Calgary, Alberta, and has built a practice focused on its clients over many years, with nearly thirty years of commercial and residential real estate law experience. Its work is organized under four headings: real estate, foreclosure, restrictive covenants and litigation. The office is on 40 Avenue NW in northwest Calgary. The firm works to build long-lasting relationships with the people it represents.
resolutions-law-corporation:
Resolutions Law Corporation is a Burnaby firm handling family law, wills and probate, inheritance disputes and real estate disputes.

The firm is led by Andrew Rebane, who joined the Law Society of British Columbia on August 24, 1993 and began in Chilliwack Supreme Court chambers acting in family and criminal matters. By 1997 his practice was focused solely on family law, for clients ranging from business owners to women in transition houses. The firm's motto is Assertive measures to achieve reasonable objectives, and its estate litigation work draws on knowledge of Lower Mainland property values.
reynolds-mirth-richards-farmer-llp:
Reynolds Mirth Richards & Farmer LLP is an Edmonton firm with a history dating to 1915, handling litigation, real estate, employment and business matters. It is a full-service practice rooted in Edmonton that acts locally, nationally and internationally, with many client relationships spanning decades.

The alternative dispute resolution group acts as counsel and as arbitrators, mediators, hearing officers and chairs of statutory hearing panels, and Donald C.I. Lucky, KC, is a partner in that group. The firm also handles constitutional and Charter work and promotes municipal law events, including the Central and Northern Municipal Law Seminars and an SDAB training workshop.
ricketts-harris-llp:
Ricketts Harris LLP is a Toronto firm handling family law, civil litigation, employment and insurance matters from an office at 250 Yonge Street.

The office sits on the 22nd floor of a building attached to the CF Toronto Eaton Centre, with direct access to the PATH network, and reception is open on weekdays. The firm has acted in high-profile cases and landmark decisions while giving clients individual attention, and thoughtfulness marks its approach. robb-macdonald-toronto:

Partner Terio Francis grew up in Toronto, studied at Dalhousie's Schulich School of Law, and has appeared before the Superior Court of Justice and the License Appeal Tribunal and arbitrated at the Financial Services Commission of Ontario. The team also includes associate KristoFer Angle, licensed paralegal Licia Lionessa, Andrea Seecharan and Andreea Savin, and the head office is on Traders Boulevard East.
turbide-avocat:
Turbide Avocat is a Levis business law practice handling incorporations, contracts and shareholder agreements across Quebec.

The practice serves entrepreneurs, small and medium-sized businesses, professionals and athletes, and offers defined legal services at displayed prices through an online client portal, with meetings held remotely or in person. Packages include federal and Quebec incorporation, shareholder agreements for two or three shareholders, and 30- or 60-minute meetings. A separate incorporation package is aimed at physicians, dentists, pharmacists, engineers, architects, accountants and other regulated professionals.
tz-law-calgary:
TZ Law is a Calgary boutique handling employment, human rights and privacy law for employees and employers across Alberta and British Columbia.

Its work covers wrongful termination, discrimination, privacy and contractual matters, and it advises people on whether to accept a severance offer or sign a release. It also acts for businesses, including start-ups and entrepreneurs dealing with growth, compliance and risk. Fee options are contingency, hourly and hybrid arrangements. The full range of services is provided in both English and Mandarin. The office is on 11 Avenue SW in downtown Calgary.
unified-immigration-lawyers-toronto:
Unified Immigration Lawyers is a Toronto firm handling Canadian and American immigration applications, appeals and sponsorships.

The firm was formerly known as Matkowsky Immigration Law and was founded in 2017. It acts for individuals, families and corporations, with work ranging from Federal Court appeals and spousal sponsorship to executive work visas. Clients deal directly with lawyers rather than consultants or paralegals, and the firm works on flat fees. Sonia Akilov is associated with the firm, and a step-by-step process takes each file from first meeting to filing.
unified-llp-toronto:
Unified LLP is a Toronto firm handling long-term disability, family, real estate, labour and employment matters for clients across Ontario.

The firm has offices in Toronto and also serves the GTA and Kitchener. On the labour side it acts for unions, not individual grievors, in grievance arbitration, tribunals, professional regulators and courts. Its family group handles uncontested and contested divorces, separation agreements, support and parenting, with flat-fee options for straightforward matters. For disability cases, it helps people whose short-term or long-term benefits are denied, delayed or cut off, and some matters proceed on a contingency fee basis.
valin-partners-llp:
Valin Partners LLP is a full-service North Bay firm, founded in 1936, covering real estate, corporate, estates, employment, family and litigation matters.

The firm was founded by Ken Valin and Bill Flannery, and it serves North Bay, Callander, Nipissing, Parry Sound and New Liskeard. Areas include residential and commercial real estate, incorporations and mergers, wills and powers of attorney, estate litigation, municipal law and construction law. Its team includes Gordon A. Prisco, Kathleen N. Klein, Andrew D. Lawson, Brianne M. Levasseur and others, and several past lawyers were elevated to the bench, including Senior Regional Judge Spyros Loukidelis.
vallillee-family-lawyers-london:
Vallillee Family Lawyers is a London, Ontario boutique handling separation, divorce, parenting, support, property and Children's Aid Society matters.

The firm accepts family cases at the London and St. Thomas courthouses, including motions to change and contempt motions, and matters involving the Children's Aid Society of London & Middlesex. Services include separation agreements, court litigation, and Voice of the Child reports for children aged seven to fifteen, or older with special needs. Lawyer David is a Western University law graduate who also flies for the animal rescue charity Pilots4Paws. The firm acts for parents, grandparents and other family members.
van-looyen-and-fallon-law-professional-c:
Van Looyen and Fallon is a Hamilton family law firm that also serves Brantford and surrounding areas, practising family law exclusively.

The firm is run by a wife and husband team, Emily Van Looyen and Patrick Fallon. Emily has practised family law for eight years and appears in the Ontario Court of Justice, the Superior Court of Justice and Unified Family Courts. She is a trained Collaborative Practice professional, acts as an agent for the Office of the Children's Lawyer, supervises for Pro Bono Students Canada and sits on the board of a Hamilton community agency. The team also includes a legal assistant and a law clerk, and the firm takes an organized, personal approach to each matter.
varity-law:
Varity Law is a Richmond Hill firm handling probate and estates, real estate, and corporate and commercial law for families and business owners.

Probate comes first, with work for executors that includes the application, court filings and monitoring until the Certificate of Appointment is issued. The firm does not handle estate litigation or disputes. Its team includes Sabrina Ding, an Osgoode Hall graduate whose team has closed real estate purchases, sales and refinances since 2017, and Jonathan Thibert, along with law clerks. On the business side, it advises on incorporation, contracts, buy-sell arrangements and succession, and serves clients across Ontario.
veale-law:
Veale Law is a Vancouver personal injury firm with an office on the 13th floor at 1500 West Georgia Street.

The firm is listed under personal injury in Vancouver, British Columbia. Details about its lawyers, services or approach are not recorded in this entry, which is limited to the firm's name, its office address and its practice area.
velandia-pouyes-avocats:
Velandia & Pouyes Avocats is a criminal defence firm in Rosemere, Quebec, handling impaired driving, sexual offence, domestic violence and fraud charges. Also known as VP Avocats, the practice is concentrated on criminal law and supports accused people in Quebec with rigour and clarity.

The firm has four core practice areas plus an emergency path for people who have just been arrested or whose relative is detained, with round-the-clock availability. Economic offences it handles include fraud, theft, breach of trust, forged documents and money laundering. Cases in a conjugal context carry conditions from the first appearance, such as orders prohibiting communication. Release hearings are also among its matters. The office is on Chemin de la Grande-Côte.
veritas-avocats:
Veritas Avocats is a Laval firm focused on family law, including divorce, separation, common-law couples, child support and child custody. Its lawyers keep clients informed of important developments and stay available to answer questions throughout a matter.

Civil litigation is also among its practice areas, and a fair hourly rate applies whatever the complexity of the file. Family disputes are difficult when emotions are involved, so files are taken on quickly from the first exchange, and transparency and communication are part of the firm's values. The office is at 271 Rue Corbin, Suite 201.
verreau-dufresne-avocats:
Verreau Dufresne Avocats is a Levis firm serving Québec City and Lévis in civil litigation, business, family and labour law.

The firm offers three kinds of mandate: full handling of a lawsuit with a lean toward negotiated settlement, an a la carte supervision service for people representing themselves in court, and advice and representation where no court file exists. Its business law division works with start-up, growing and established companies in commercial and corporate matters, and many of its business lawyers have been entrepreneurs themselves.
vickers-law-group:
Vickers Law Group is an Abbotsford firm offering legal guidance in civil litigation, probate and employment throughout the Fraser Valley.

The firm is also listed under business law and contracts, with an office on McCallum Road in Abbotsford, British Columbia. Details about its lawyers, history and approach are not recorded in this entry, which is limited to the firm's name, location, address and practice areas.
vml-family-law-llp-calgary:
VML Family Law LLP is a Calgary family law firm offering divorce, custody, child support, mediation, arbitration and litigation services.

The team includes mediators, arbitrators, parenting coordinators and litigators. Services also include asset and debt separation, adoption, child abduction law, prenuptial agreements, legal coaching and the preparation of agreements and legal documents. Emily Varga is a co-founding partner, and the team also includes Holly McCord Lonseth, Suman Parmar, Tanisha Smith, Anne Marie Harrison, Danijela Radinovic, Caleigh Hunt, Hannah Grant and Kamiko Bosch. The firm takes a compassionate approach to emotionally charged family matters and has an office on 4 Street SW.
vrs-law-firm:
VRS Law Firm is a Kitchener firm preparing wills and powers of attorney and acting in probate and real estate matters, including for Cambridge clients.

Varun Sharma, who received his law degree from the University of New Brunswick and a BA from McMaster University, was admitted to the Ontario bar in 2012. His real estate work covers buying, selling and refinancing for first-time purchasers through to downsizers, and he assists lenders, investors and companies. Andrew Captan is also with the firm. Up-front fee quotes are offered for real estate matters, and estate planning is personalized, including choosing who manages affairs and who looks after children.
vsr-law-professional-corporation:
VSR Law Professional Corporation is a Mississauga firm handling real estate, personal injury, immigration, debt consolidation and notarial services.

Its real estate practice covers purchases, sales, refinancing and closings, and it also serves clients in Kitchener, Cambridge and Brampton. The personal injury side covers cases arising from car accidents, bicycle accidents, dog bites, pedestrian collisions, chronic pain and psychological injury, and catastrophic injury. The firm acts for injured people across Ontario, and legal fees on injury cases are payable only if compensation is recovered. It also handles immigration matters and builds a case strategy from the start of each file.
wahab-law-kitchener:
Wahab Law is a Kitchener firm handling real estate, family, employment, wills and estate, and civil litigation matters.

The firm serves Kitchener, Waterloo, Cambridge, the Greater Toronto Area and surrounding regions. Khaled Wahab is the managing lawyer, with Nima Pannu as an associate and Richard David Christy as executive advisor. Real estate work covers buying, selling and refinancing with transparent pricing, while the family practice handles custody disputes, support calculations, asset distribution and divorce. Notary services and independent legal advice are also offered, and clients are served throughout the Waterloo Region.
walsh-llp:
Walsh LLP is a full-service Calgary firm serving Southern Alberta, with practices in agriculture, business, litigation and real estate law. It has more than sixty-five years of history across four generations and five offices: Calgary, Canmore, Okotoks, Claresholm and Stand Off.

Practice areas include agriculture law, alternative dispute resolution, business and corporate law, civil and commercial litigation, commercial real estate, construction litigation and employment law. The agriculture group covers business structure, succession planning, banking and financing, and several Walsh lawyers have been active farmers. Most of the firm's work comes from long-standing clients, and it aims to give advice in plain language.
warnett-hallen-llp:
Warnett Hallen LLP is a Vancouver personal injury firm handling auto accident, slip and fall and other serious injury cases.

The firm was founded by personal injury lawyers Paul Warnett and Manjot Hallen, and its partners each have decades of experience litigating injury cases. It works on a contingency fee basis, so legal fees are paid only if compensation is recovered, and acts for clients in Vancouver and across British Columbia. It also covers dental malpractice. British Columbia has operated under a no-fault system for motor vehicle accidents since May 1, 2021.
waseer-law-office-london:
Waseer Law Office is a London, Ontario firm handling immigration, real estate, family law, and wills and estates for clients in seven languages.

The practice is led by Zia Waseer, who is a barrister and solicitor in Ontario and a solicitor in England and Wales. He holds a law degree from London Metropolitan University and has over 15 years of experience with a focus on Canadian immigration law. The office is on Richmond Street in London, and many real estate and immigration matters can be handled remotely. The wills and estates practice covers wills, powers of attorney, probate and estate administration for clients in London, Windsor, Mississauga and surrounding areas.
watchmaker-law-car-accident-and-personal:
Watchmaker Law is an Edmonton firm handling car accident, personal injury and civil litigation matters for clients across Alberta.

Founder David Sowemimo represents plaintiffs in serious and catastrophic injury cases, from paraplegic and quadriplegic injuries to multi-fatality collisions, and draws on alternative dispute resolution experience. Associates Wura Oshodi and Erin Castro are also with the firm, and services are available in English and Yoruba. Its injury practice covers psychological injuries, fractures, traumatic brain injuries, whiplash, burns and chronic pain. The firm works on a contingency fee basis and offers flexible meeting options for clients whose injuries make travel difficult.
weaver-simmons-llp:
Weaver Simmons LLP is a Sudbury firm of more than 30 full-time lawyers handling litigation, criminal, corporate, real estate, mining and family law.

The firm has more than 90 years of service and over 60 support staff including law clerks and students. Its practice areas also cover commercial, aboriginal, natural resources and labour and employment law, and it has a personal injury team. Services are offered in both official languages, Ojibwe, Greek and Italian, and clients include institutions, businesses, families and individuals throughout Ontario. The firm has supported more than 60 charitable and community organizations. The office is on Brady Street in Sudbury.
weirfoulds-llp:
WeirFoulds LLP is a Toronto law firm organized around four areas: litigation, corporate, property and government law.

The firm was founded in 1860. Fourteen of its lawyers have been appointed judges by the federal government, the first in 1883 and the most recent in 2021, and eight of them went to courts of appeal, including the Supreme Court of Canada. Past and current lawyers have also served as Treasurers and Benchers of the Law Society of Ontario. Its news and insights cover employment law, construction contracts, commercial litigation and estates.
west-legal-calgary:
West Legal is a Calgary team of lawyers handling wills and estates, probate, family, employment and residential real estate matters.

The firm takes a People First approach and serves Calgary, Okotoks and Airdrie. David West practises in real estate, wills and probate, Kim Nutz in employment law for both employees and employers, Machelle Luiters in family law and Kelsey Morrison in wills and estate planning. Adrienne O'Reilly handles corporate, securities, mergers and acquisitions and commercial work. West Legal offers flat-rate fees wherever possible, including for wills, enduring powers of attorney, personal directives, probate and residential real estate transactions.
westcoast-wills-and-estates-vancouver:
Westcoast Wills & Estates is a Vancouver firm of lawyers handling wills, trusts, probate, estate disputes and related corporate and family law.

The firm has offices in Vancouver, North Vancouver, Surrey, Burnaby and Richmond. Ninety-five percent of its clients are charged flat rates, and it donates 1 percent of its revenue to charity and tries to limit its environmental impact. Lawyers on the team include Jessica Poon, Aron Chitsaz, Katrina Law, Nick Russell, Harleen Sandhu and Joanna Tu. Representative work includes helping siblings settle a parent's estate through a probate application, and its lawyers present publicly on estate topics.
what-the-law:
What The Law is an Aurora criminal defence firm founded by Mustafa Sheikh, handling impaired driving and other criminal charges across Ontario.

The firm, styled WhatTheLaw, handles all criminal charges at all Ontario courthouses and offers flat-rate fees with flexible payment plans. A large team of criminal lawyers works collaboratively, with availability around the clock. Mr. Sheikh has appeared on CTV, CBC, Global News and CP24. Richmond Hill and the wider Greater Toronto Area are also part of its service area.
white-and-jeet-criminal-defence-calgary:
White & Jeet Criminal Defence is a Calgary team of criminal lawyers with offices in Lethbridge, Medicine Hat and Red Deer, serving all of Alberta.

Practice areas include violent and serious charges, sexual assault, murder and homicide, drug and controlled substance offences, financial and complex matters, and criminal driving offences. The firm also handles administration of justice offences, such as breaches of release conditions or probation under section 145 of the Criminal Code. Its work runs from early investigation and bail hearings through trial, appeals and post-conviction matters, and it operates a round-the-clock help line.
white-macgillivray-lester-llp-thunder-ba:
White Macgillivray Lester LLP is a Thunder Bay personal injury firm serving clients across Northwestern Ontario.

Its areas of work include slip and falls, vehicle collisions, insurance disputes and long term disability, and its team consists of injury lawyers and agents. Its lawyers and staff live in the region, unlike firms headquartered in Toronto, and it has helped people from the Manitoba border in the west to Marathon in the east, as well as in the far northern communities. The office is at 1 Cumberland Street South, and Dan Lester is among its lawyers.
whitestone-law-ottawa:
Whitestone Law is an Ottawa firm providing corporate and commercial law, real estate transactions and estate planning for clients across Ontario.

The firm acts for businesses, individuals and families, and clients work directly with their lawyer for continuity and clear communication. Corporate work covers mergers and acquisitions, incorporations, restructuring, contract drafting and regulatory compliance, with ongoing advisory and general counsel services available. Real estate files include buying, selling and refinancing, and estate planning centres on wills and inheritance planning. Costs are explained before work starts, and every lawyer on the team is licensed in Ontario.
williams-litigation-lawyers-llp:
Williams Litigation Lawyers LLP is an Ottawa civil litigation firm covering insurance, personal injury, estate and commercial disputes.

Areas of work include insurance law, personal injury, estate litigation, commercial litigation, employment litigation, professional liability and long-term disability. The lawyers include Kelly P. Hart, Eric R. Williams, Tara Lemke, Jeremy R. Rubenstein, Ashlee L. Barber, David Cutler, Gabrielle Parsons and Gabriella Gader. Kelly Hart and Eric Williams were included in the 2027 edition of a Canadian lawyer directory.
williams-litigation-north-north-bay:
Williams Litigation North is a North Bay civil litigation firm covering insurance, personal injury, long-term disability and professional liability.

The firm works as Williams Litigation Lawyers from 176 Lakeshore Drive. Its approach is modern counsel with classic care, doing law differently. Its team includes Ashlee L. Barber, Kelly P. Hart, Tara Lemke, Jeremy R. Rubenstein, Eric R. Williams, David Cutler, Gabrielle Parsons and Gabriella Gader. Two of its lawyers were included in a Canadian lawyer ranking publication.
wishart-law-firm:
Wishart Law Firm LLP handles corporate, commercial, civil litigation, real estate and municipal law in Sault Ste. Marie for clients across Ontario.

The firm's history begins in 1900, when Moses and Uriah McFadden opened an office at Brock and Queen Streets. Ernest McMillan joined after Moses became a judge in 1915, and when Arthur Wishart arrived from Blind River in 1939 the firm became Wishart and McMillan. After the Second World War the practice accepted an appointment as solicitor for the city. It also provides business planning, wills and estates and residential real estate work, and the office is on Bay Street.
witten-llp:
Witten LLP is an Edmonton firm practising real estate and wills and estates, at 2500 Canadian Western Bank Place on Jasper Avenue.

The firm is listed under real estate and wills and estates in Alberta. Details of its lawyers, history and approach are not recorded in this entry, which is limited to the firm's name, address, city and practice areas.
wolf-law-mississauga:
Wolf Law, based in Mississauga, advises lenders, investors and businesses on real estate transactions, commercial lending and mergers and acquisitions.

The firm acts for purchasers, lenders, private credit funds and developers across Ontario and internationally. The lending side covers secured and unsecured arrangements such as acquisition financing, real estate development financing, bridge loans and asset-based lending. Its commercial real estate work includes acquisitions, dispositions, title searches and due diligence, and joint venture agreements for development projects. The corporate side includes share and asset purchases, joint ventures and cross-border business transactions.
wolseley-law-llp-winnipeg:
Wolseley Law LLP is a Winnipeg community law firm handling wills, estates, real estate, family, business and litigation matters. Partners Gerrit Theule, Tim Brown and Leah Unruh founded the firm in the Wolseley neighbourhood, where Gerrit grew up and lives, to serve everyday issues rather than large downtown clients.

Services include buying, selling and mortgaging property, wills, estates and elder law, family law through collaboration, negotiation and mediation, litigation, and business and non-profit work. The firm also offers assisted self-representation, with unbundled services and legal coaching, and publishes flat-fee pricing for matters that progress consistently. The office is at 120 Sherbrook Street.
woods-llp:
Woods LLP is a Montreal law firm with litigation and employment law as its recorded practice areas.

Its office is at 2000 McGill College Avenue, Suite 1700, Montreal, Quebec. Details about its lawyers, courts or approach are not recorded in this entry, which is limited to the firm's name, address, city and practice areas.
wvgb-personal-injury-lawyers-ottawa:
WVGB Personal Injury Lawyers is an Ottawa firm acting for people hurt in car crashes, falls, brain injuries and other accidents.

WVGB Law Group was established in 2021 through a partnership between Villeneuve Litigation P.C. and Wolfe Lawyers P.C., and serves English and French speaking communities in Ottawa and the Ottawa Valley. Clients work directly with a partner who oversees the case personally. Practice areas cover car accidents, slip and trip and falls, brain injuries, animal attacks and rideshare and taxi accidents, along with wills and estates, and the time limits that apply to injury cases are explained.
wyman-and-williamson-criminal-defence-la:
Wyman & Williamson is a Calgary criminal defence firm that handles only Criminal Code prosecutions, with a focus on sexual assault and impaired driving.

Its lawyers act at all levels of court in Alberta, have made several appearances before the Supreme Court of Canada, and take cases throughout Western Canada. The firm handles domestic assault matters, including the conditions police impose barring communication after a domestic incident, and covers simple and aggravated assault, threats and bail conditions. The consequences of a sexual assault conviction include possible incarceration and registration on the sex offender registry. The Calgary office sits on Seventh Avenue SW.
ylaw-vancouver:
YLaw is a Vancouver firm handling family, employment, estate litigation, immigration and strata law matters across British Columbia.

The firm has offices in Vancouver, Langley and Chilliwack, and also serves Surrey. Its family lawyers deal with divorce, common-law separation, asset and debt division, spousal and child support and parenting time, plus mediation. The employment group covers wrongful dismissal, severance, contracts and workplace equity, while estate litigators handle will disputes and unfair wills. YLaw also handles civil litigation and class actions. It does not treat every case as a battle and focuses on a client's long-term family, career and financial interests.
z-legal-litigation-lawyer-toronto:
Z Legal is a Toronto litigation firm handling estate, employment, commercial and family disputes and professional misconduct matters.

Founder Martin Zatovkanuk is a litigation lawyer with more than a decade of experience before all levels of Ontario courts. The firm represents clients from the outset of a matter to its end, whether it resolves by settlement, mediation, arbitration or trial. Its employment practice acts for employees and employers on wrongful dismissal, severance pay, constructive dismissal and workplace harassment across Toronto and the GTA, while the firm also covers real estate litigation and will challenges. Flat-rate and contingency fee options are available.
zacharias-mccann-llp:
Zacharias McCann LLP (ZM LLP) is an Abbotsford firm handling civil litigation, personal injury, employment, family and commercial matters.

The firm acts across British Columbia, Alberta and the Yukon and covers commercial litigation, contract law, disability law, class actions, real estate, corporate law, and governance and workplace law for First Nations. Its family law team works on separation agreements, mediation, court applications and trials, alongside accountants, business valuators, real estate appraisers, pension valuators and counsellors. Its lawyers have more than 100 years of combined experience.
zaifman-immigration-lawyers-winnipeg:
Zaifman Immigration Lawyers is a Winnipeg firm handling Canadian immigration applications for individuals, employers and international students.

Kenneth Zaifman founded the firm in 1986 after taking his first immigration case, R. v. Cole, in 1979. The staff of twelve includes lawyers and Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultants, and service is offered in Chinese, Spanish, Korean, Tagalog, Punjabi and Hindi. The firm assists applicants destined for any province under federal programs and Provincial Nominee Programs, helps Canadian employers fill labour needs, and supports students planning to study in Manitoba.
zamani-law-toronto:
Zamani Law is a Toronto criminal defence firm that represents people facing criminal allegations across the Greater Toronto Area.

Practice areas include bail hearings and domestic violence charges, and the firm's priority is protecting clients' rights while seeking a reasonable resolution or withdrawal of charges. For family law, wills and estate planning and real estate, it has alliances with other practitioners to whom it directs clients, since family disputes are often linked to criminal proceedings. Founder Farid Zamani is a co-founder of Children without Borders, a non-profit that raises awareness of child labour and sponsors education for children in Afghan communities. The office is on Richmond Street West.
zargarian-litigation:
Zargarian Litigation is a Nanaimo criminal defence firm defending assault, sexual assault, impaired driving, firearms and fraud charges.

It acts across British Columbia. Babak Zargarian and Zoe Arghandewal handle every file personally. Babak Zargarian has conducted cases at every level of court in the province and before the Supreme Court of Canada, and he practises in both trials and appeals. The firm serves Nanaimo, Campbell River, Courtenay, Duncan, Port Alberni and Smithers, and takes cases from Vancouver Island to Prince Rupert.
zomorodi-law-pc-richmond-hill:
Zomorodi Law PC is a Richmond Hill firm offering real estate transactions, business law, civil and commercial litigation, and wills and estates.

Its real estate practice covers purchase, sale and mortgage closings for urban and cottage properties, condominiums and vacant land, both residential and commercial. Business services include articles of incorporation, shareholder agreements and the sale or acquisition of franchised businesses, and notary public services are also offered. The firm serves newcomers, business owners, young entrepreneurs, other professionals, international investors and diverse communities, and its litigation experience lets it handle disputes that arise during a closing in house.
zoom-law-calgary:
Zoom Law is a Calgary firm practising only injury law, from car accidents and hit and runs to motorcycle, pedestrian and cycling crashes.

Its car accident work covers rear-end collisions, impaired or distracted driving, uninsured motorists and wrongful death. The firm works across Alberta and offers service in English, Arabic, Russian, Polish, Ukrainian, Tagalog, Urdu, Punjabi, Hindi and Kurdish. It also guides clients through chronic injury matters and recovery, with the Calgary office as its base.
zubic-law:
Zubic Law is a Niagara Falls firm handling residential and commercial real estate, corporate matters, wills, powers of attorney and probate.

Zubic Law Professional Corporation and Anya Zubic Professional Law Corporation both operate under the Zubic Law name. Real estate services include contract negotiation, due diligence and closings for buyers and sellers, as well as mortgage refinancing, with separate real estate coverage for Welland, St. Catharines, Airdrie and Okotoks. On the estates side, it guides executors and beneficiaries through probate and estate administration. The office is on Victoria Avenue in Niagara Falls.
